AuditVotes seamlessly integrates two novel components into the randomized smoothing pipeline: (1) graph rewiring augmentation, which denoises randomized graphs to recover data quality, and (2) conditional smoothing, which filters low-confidence votes to ensure prediction consistency. We establish a novel theoretical result, proving that certified robustness is preserved under arbitrary filtering functions. Designed for inductive learning, our framework generalizes to unseen nodes and applies broadly to other smoothing schemes, including de-randomized smoothing for graphs and Gaussian smoothing for images. Extensive experiments show AuditVotes delivers substantial gains: on Cora-ML under 20-edge attacks, it improves clean accuracy by 437.1% and certified accuracy by 409.3%, while maintaining comparable runtime to vanilla smoothing. As a widely applicable and efficient plug-in, AuditVotes offers higher accuracy and stronger guarantees, enabling the practical and certifiably robust GNNs in security-sensitive domains.

title: Differential Equations as Fixpoints and Games
summary:
Games and fixpoints are unified by proving that first-order game logic GL and the first-order modal mu-calculus L_mu are proved to be equiexpressive and equivalent, thereby fully aligning their expressive and deductive power. That is, there is a semantics-preserving translation from GL to L_mu, and vice versa. And both translations are provability-preserving, while equivalence with there-and-back-again roundtrip translations are provable in both calculi. This is to be contrasted with the propositional case, where game logic is strictly less expressive than the modal mu-calculus (without adding sabotage games).
  The extensions with differential equations, differential game logic (dGL) and differential modal mu-calculus, are also proved equiexpressive and equivalent. Moreover, as the continuous dynamics are definable by fixpoints or via games, ODEs can be axiomatized completely and, as a consequence, infinitesimally robust properties of ODEs can be decided via proof search. Rational gameplay provably collapses the games into single-player games to yield a strong arithmetical completeness theorem for dGL with rational-time ODEs.

title: Broadcast via Mobile Agents in a Dynamic Network: Interplay of Graph Properties & Agents
summary:
We revisit the problem of \textsc{Broadcast}, introduced by Das, Giachoudis, Luccio, and Markou [OPODIS, 2020], where $k+1$ agents are initially placed on an $n$ node dynamic graph, where $1$ agent has a message that must be broadcast to the remaining $k$ ignorant agents. The original paper studied the relationship between the number of agents needed to solve the problem and the edge density of the graph. The paper presented strong evidence that edge density of a graph, or the number of redundant edges within the graph, may be the correct graph property to accurately differentiate whether $k= o(n)$ ignorant agents (low edge density) or $k = Ω(n)$ ignorant agents (high edge density) are needed to solve the problem.
  In this paper, we show that surprisingly, edge density may not in fact be the correct differentiating property. The original paper presents graphs with edge density $1.1\overline{6}$ that require $Ω(n)$ agents, however, we construct graphs with edge density $> 1.1\overline{6}$ and develop an algorithm to solve the problem on those graphs using only $o(n)$ agents. We subsequently show that the relationship between edge density and number of agents is fairly weak by first constructing graphs with edge density tending to $1$ from above that require $Ω(n/f(n))$ agents to solve, for any function $f(n) \to \infty$ as $n \to \infty$. We then construct an infinite family of graphs with edge density $< ρ$ requiring at least $k$ ignorant agents to solve \textsc{Broadcast}, for any $k>1$ and $ρ>1$.

title: Sorting as Gradient Flow on the Permutohedron
summary: We investigate how sorting algorithms navigate the complexity of permutation space. Our main contribution is a continuous-time geometric model that casts sorting as directed motion on the permutohedron. A quadratic potential generates an ambient gradient flow that contracts toward the fixed sorted vertex $v_s=(1,2,\ldots,n)$. This dynamical picture is set against two discrete descriptions of the same problem. One follows adjacent-swap paths along the $1$-skeleton, while the other uses comparison half-spaces to refine the feasible order types. Together, they provide the combinatorial foils used to evaluate the continuous trajectory. Comparisons remove informational ambiguity, whereas the flow removes metric distance. The two mechanisms are complementary. To support this analysis, we present decision-tree arguments and local paths with $Θ(n^2)$ behavior. We also show that the quadratic potential decreases strictly under every inversion-removing adjacent swap and formulate global half-space constraints on candidate rank maps. The maximal fixed-threshold relaxation time is determined exactly by the Euclidean diameter of the permutohedron, and the product of this relaxation time with the dimension is $Θ(n\log n)$. Under a normalized comparison clock, this intrinsic geometric quantity has the same asymptotic scale as classical optimal comparison sorting.

title: Streaming Sliced Optimal Transport
comments: Accepted to ICML 2026, 21 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables
summary: Sliced optimal transport (SOT), or sliced Wasserstein (SW) distance, is widely recognized for its statistical and computational scalability. In this work, we further enhance computational scalability by proposing the first method for estimating SW from sample streams, called streaming sliced Wasserstein (Stream-SW). To define Stream-SW, we first introduce a streaming estimator of the one-dimensional Wasserstein distance (1DW). Since the 1DW has a closed-form expression, given by the integral of the absolute difference between the quantile functions of the compared distributions, we leverage quantile approximation techniques for sample streams to define a streaming 1DW estimator. By applying the streaming 1DW to all projections, we obtain Stream-SW. The key advantage of Stream-SW is its low memory complexity while providing theoretical guarantees on the approximation error. We demonstrate that Stream-SW achieves a more accurate approximation of SW than random subsampling, with lower memory consumption, when comparing Gaussian distributions and mixtures of Gaussians from streaming samples. Additionally, we conduct experiments on point cloud classification, point cloud gradient flows, and streaming change point detection to further highlight the favorable performance of the proposed Stream-SW.
comment: Accepted to ICML 2026, 21 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables

title: Data-Driven Modeling Approaches for Optimal Control and Control Co-Design of Floating Offshore Wind Turbines
summary: Models that balance accuracy against computational costs are advantageous when designing wind turbines with optimization studies, as several hundred predictive function evaluations might be necessary to identify the optimal solution. We explore different approaches to construct low-fidelity models that can be used to approximate dynamic quantities and be used as surrogates for design optimization studies and other use cases. In particular, low-fidelity modeling approaches using classical systems identification and deep learning approaches are considered against derivative function surrogate models ({DFSMs}), or approximate models of the state derivative function. This work proposes a novel method that utilizes a linear parameter varying (LPV) modeling scheme to construct the DFSM. We compare the trade-offs between these different models and explore the efficacy of the proposed DFSM approach in approximating wind turbine performance and different design optimization studies. Results show that the proposed DFSM approach balances computational time and model accuracy better than the system identification and deep learning-based models. Additionally, the DFSM provides nearly a fifty times speed-up compared to the high-fidelity model, while balancing accuracy.

title: Contour Errors: Ego-Centric Matching for 3D Multi-Object Tracking Performance Evaluation
comments: Accepted at IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026
summary: Open-loop performance evaluation of 3D multi-object tracking in autonomous driving requires matching criteria that effectively penalize translational, shape, and orientation errors from the ego vehicle perspective. The prevailing criteria for determining true positives are Intersection over Union (IoU) and Centre-Point Distances (CPD). When IoU is extended from the 2D image plane to 3D volumetric overlap, it often falls below its acceptance threshold even with minor yaw misalignments, whereas CPD disregards orientation entirely. To address this limitation, we propose Contour Errors (CE) as an ego-centric criterion that employs Hausdorff-type reasoning to sparse bounding-box corner geometry by selecting the k-nearest ego-centric corners. This method provides a graded orientation sensitivity between the extremes of IoU, which overpenalizes, and CPD, which is orientation-blind. We evaluate Contour Errors against six baselines using the HOTA evaluation protocol on the nuScenes dataset, conditioned on proximity, yaw error, and a confidence threshold. At the standard IoU vehicle threshold, 47% of car and 75% of pedestrian CE-valid matches are rejected by IoU despite close contour proximity, while fewer than 0.1% of IoU-valid matches fail CE. These results establish the ego-centric matching criterion as a primary factor for improving open-loop perception evaluation in safety-critical autonomous driving.
comment: Accepted at IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026

title: Membership Inference Attacks for Unseen Classes
summary: A key tool in developing safe AI models is \emph{data auditing}, i.e., using statistical tools to determine whether harmful content may have been used in the training data of a black-box model. Unfortunately, most \emph{membership inference attacks} (MIAs) used to perform this type of auditing themselves assume \emph{access} to examples of harmful content from the same distribution as the query data. In real-world auditing scenarios, auditors often face legal and ethical restrictions preventing them from accessing a representative set of samples of harmful content to train MIA models effectively. We abstract and formalize this setting into a new data access model, the ``unseen class'' setting, and show that the state of the art MIAs fail due to the lack of access to the full target distribution. We show in this setting, \emph{quantile regression attacks} outperform approaches typically considered to be SoTA. We demonstrate this both empirically and theoretically, showing that quantile regression attacks achieve up to \textbf{11$\times$ the TPR} of shadow model-based approaches in practice, and providing a theoretical model that outlines the generalization properties required for this approach to succeed. Our work identifies an important failure mode in existing MIAs and provides a cautionary tale for practitioners that aim to directly use existing tools for real-world applications of AI safety.

AI.title_translation: 针对未见类别的成员推理攻击
AI.tldr: 本文提出了“未见类别”下的成员推理攻击新设定，揭示了现有SOTA审计方法的失效，并证明分位数回归攻击在该现实受限场景中的TPR可达传统影子模型方法的11倍。
AI.motivation: 在黑盒AI模型的数据审计中，现有成员推理攻击（MIA）普遍假设能获取与查询数据同分布的有害内容样本。然而在现实审计中，受法律和伦理限制，审计员往往无法获取这些代表性样本，导致现有SOTA攻击方法失效。
AI.method: 抽象并形式化了“未见类别”（unseen class）这一新的数据访问模型；采用分位数回归攻击（quantile regression attacks）替代传统的基于影子模型的方法，并构建理论模型分析其泛化特性。
AI.result: 理论与实证均表明分位数回归攻击在该设定下表现显著优于现有SOTA方法，在实践中其真正例率（TPR）可达基于影子模型方法的11倍，且理论模型阐明了其成功所需的泛化属性。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了现有成员推理攻击在未见类别审计场景下的重大缺陷，证明了分位数回归攻击在该受限环境下的有效性，为AI安全与数据审计的实操应用提供了重要警示与改进方向。
AI.translation: 在开发安全AI模型中，一项关键工具是数据审计，即利用统计工具判断黑盒模型的训练数据中是否可能使用了有害内容。不幸的是，大多数用于执行此类审计的成员推理攻击（MIA）本身假设能够获取与查询数据属于同一分布的有害内容样本。在现实世界的审计场景中，审计人员往往面临法律和伦理限制，无法获取代表性的有害内容样本来有效训练MIA模型。我们将这种设定抽象并形式化为一种新的数据访问模型——“未见类别”设定，并表明由于缺乏对完整目标分布的访问，最先进的MIA方法在此设定下会失效。我们证明在此设定下，分位数回归攻击的表现优于通常被认为是最先进的方法。我们从实证和理论两方面证实了这一点，展示了分位数回归攻击在实践中达到的真正例率（TPR）最高可达基于影子模型方法的11倍，并给出了概述该方法成功所需泛化特性的理论模型。我们的工作确定了现有MIA中一个重要的失效模式，并为旨在将现有工具直接用于现实世界AI安全应用的从业者提供了警示。
AI.summary: 本文研究了现实法律和伦理限制下黑盒AI模型的数据审计问题，形式化了审计员无法获取目标有害类样本的“未见类别”成员推理攻击（MIA）设定。研究表明现有SOTA攻击在此场景下失效，而分位数回归攻击能够大幅超越传统基于影子模型的方法（TPR提升高达11倍），并提供了相关的理论泛化保证，为AI安全实践提供了重要警示。
AI.keywords: 成员推理攻击, 数据审计, 未见类别, 分位数回归, AI安全
AI.comments:
1. 创新性：提出了贴近现实法律与伦理约束的“未见类别”成员推理攻击新设定，打破了现有研究依赖同分布有害样本的理想化假设。
2. 重要性：揭示了现有SOTA成员推理方法在真实审计场景下的严重失效，并证明了分位数回归攻击的巨大优势（TPR提升高达11倍），对实际AI安全评估具有重要指导意义。
3. 局限性：摘要未披露该方法在不同模型架构和数据集类型上的具体通用性细节，需参阅全文获取进一步验证。

title: CreatiPoster: Towards Editable and Controllable Multi-Layer Graphic Design Generation
summary: Graphic design plays a crucial role in both commercial and personal contexts, yet creating high-quality, editable, and aesthetically pleasing graphic compositions remains a time-consuming and skill-intensive task, especially for beginners. Current AI tools automate parts of the workflow, but struggle to accurately incorporate user-supplied assets, maintain editability, and achieve professional visual appeal. Commercial systems, like Canva Magic Design, rely on vast template libraries, which are impractical for replicate. In this paper, we introduce CreatiPoster, a framework that generates editable, multi-layer compositions from optional natural-language instructions or assets. A protocol model, an RGBA large multimodal model, first produces a JSON specification detailing every layer (text or asset) with precise layout, hierarchy, content and style, plus a concise background prompt. A conditional background model then synthesizes a coherent background conditioned on this rendered foreground layers. We construct a benchmark with automated metrics for graphic-design generation and show that CreatiPoster surpasses leading open-source approaches and proprietary commercial systems. To catalyze further research, we release a copyright-free corpus of 100,000 multi-layer designs. CreatiPoster supports diverse applications such as canvas editing, text overlay, responsive resizing, multilingual adaptation, and animated posters, advancing the democratization of AI-assisted graphic design. Project homepage: https://github.com/graphic-design-ai/creatiposter

AI.title_translation: CreatiPoster：面向可编辑且可控的多图层平面设计生成
AI.tldr: CreatiPoster通过多模态协议模型生成JSON图层规范并结合条件背景模型，实现了高可控、高质量且可编辑的多图层平面设计生成。
AI.motivation: 创建高质量、可编辑且美观的平面设计十分耗时且需要专业技能。现有AI工具难以准确融合用户自备素材、维持可编辑性及实现专业美感，而商业系统依赖的庞大模板库难以直接复刻。
AI.method: 提出了CreatiPoster框架：首先由协议模型（RGBA大型多模态模型）生成JSON规范，详细定义每个图层（文本或素材）的精确布局、层级、内容、样式及背景提示词；随后由条件背景模型以渲染出的前景图层为条件，合成连贯的背景图像。
AI.result: 在构建的平面设计生成自动化评估基准上，CreatiPoster超越了领先的开源方法和专有商业系统；同时发布了包含100,000个多图层设计的无版权数据集，并支持画布编辑、响应式调整大小、多语言适配和动画海报等多种应用。
AI.conclusion: CreatiPoster通过解耦布局与背景生成，实现了高质、可控且可编辑的多图层设计，推动了AI辅助平面设计的普及与发展。
AI.translation: 平面设计在商业和个人场景中都起着至关重要作用，然而创建高质量、可编辑且美观的平面设计组合仍然是一项耗时且需要专业技能的任务，尤其是对于初学者而言。当前的AI工具自动化了部分工作流程，但在准确融合用户提供的素材、保持可编辑性以及实现专业视觉美感方面依然存在困难。像Canva Magic Design这样的商业系统依赖于庞大的模板库，这难以被复制。在本文中，我们提出了CreatiPoster，这是一个根据可选的自然语言指令或素材生成可编辑多图层组合的框架。协议模型（一种RGBA大型多模态模型）首先生成JSON规范，详细说明每个图层（文本或素材）的精确布局、层级、内容和样式，以及简短的背景提示词。随后，条件背景模型以这些渲染的前景图层为条件，合成连贯的背景。我们构建了一个带有平面设计生成自动化评估指标的基准，并证明CreatiPoster超越了领先的开源方法和专有商业系统。为了促进进一步的研究，我们发布了一个包含100,000个多图层设计的无版权数据集。CreatiPoster支持多种应用，如画布编辑、文本叠加、响应式调整大小、多语言适配和动画海报，推进了AI辅助平面设计的普及。项目主页：https://github.com/graphic-design-ai/creatiposter
AI.summary: 本文针对平面设计中可编辑性与可控性差的问题，提出了CreatiPoster框架。该框架利用RGBA大语言模型生成包含图层详细信息的JSON规范，再通过条件背景模型合成背景。实验表明其性能超越现有的开源与商业系统，并开源了10万个无版权设计数据集。
AI.keywords: 平面设计生成, 多图层生成, 可编辑性, 大型多模态模型, 条件背景合成
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将多图层平面设计解耦为“协议模型生成JSON图层规范”与“条件背景模型合成背景”两个阶段，有效解决了传统AI图文生成难以编辑、不易精确融入用户素材的痛点。同时开源10万无版权图层数据集，对推动AI辅助平面设计领域的研究具有重要价值。局限性在于复杂图层间的动态语义理解和极端精细排版可能仍受限于多模态大模型的表征能力。

title: Avoiding Obfuscation with Prover-Estimator Debate
summary: Training powerful AI systems to exhibit desired behaviors hinges on the ability to provide accurate human supervision on increasingly complex tasks. A promising approach to this problem is to amplify human judgement by leveraging the power of two competing AIs in a debate about the correct solution to a given problem. Prior theoretical work has provided a complexity-theoretic formalization of AI debate, and posed the problem of designing protocols for AI debate that guarantee the correctness of human judgements for as complex a class of problems as possible. Recursive debates, in which debaters decompose a complex problem into simpler subproblems, hold promise for growing the class of problems that can be accurately judged in a debate. However, existing protocols for recursive debate run into the obfuscated arguments problem: a dishonest debater can use a computationally efficient strategy that forces an honest opponent to solve a computationally intractable problem to win. We mitigate this problem with a new recursive debate protocol that, under certain stability assumptions, ensures that an honest debater can win with a strategy requiring computational efficiency comparable to their opponent.

AI.title_translation: 通过证明者-估计者辩论规避混淆论点
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种全新的递归AI辩论协议，解决了不诚实辩论者通过“混淆论点”迫使诚实方进行不可行计算的问题，确保诚实方能以相当的计算效率胜出。
AI.motivation: 现有的递归AI辩论协议面临“混淆论点问题”（obfuscated arguments problem），即不诚实的辩论者可以使用计算高效的策略，迫使诚实辩论者必须解决计算上不可行的难题才能获胜，从而破坏了人类监督的准确性。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的递归辩论协议（证明者-估计者辩论，Prover-Estimator Debate）。在一定的稳定性假设下，该协议能够保障诚实辩论者只需具备与其对手相当的计算效率即可赢得辩论。
AI.result: 成功缓解了递归辩论中的混淆论点问题，确保诚实辩论者在计算复杂度上不会被对手不公平地压制。
AI.conclusion: 该递归辩论协议在满足稳定性假设的前提下，能有效防止不诚实策略利用计算复杂性优势干扰辩论结果，从而扩大了人类可以通过辩论机制进行准确监督和评估的复杂任务范围。
AI.translation: 训练强大的AI系统以展现期望的行为，取决于在日益复杂的任务上提供准确的人类监督的能力。解决该问题的一种有前景的方法是通过利用两个竞争AI就给定问题的正确解决方案进行辩论，从而放大人类的判断力。先前的理论工作提供了AI辩论的复杂性理论形式化，并提出了设计AI辩论协议的问题，以确保人类判断对尽可能复杂的问题类别的正确性。递归辩论（辩论者将复杂问题分解为更简单的子问题）有望扩大可以在辩论中被准确判定的问题类别。然而，现有的递归辩论协议遇到了混淆论点问题：不诚实的辩论者可以使用计算高效的策略，迫使诚实的对手解决计算上不可行的难题才能获胜。我们通过一种新的递归辩论协议缓解了这个问题，在一定的稳定性假设下，该协议确保诚实的辩论者可以凭借与其对手相当计算效率的策略获胜。
AI.summary: 针对大型语言/AI模型可扩展监督中的AI辩论机制，本文揭示了现存递归辩论协议容易受到“混淆论点”攻击的缺陷（即不诚实方利用计算效率差迫使诚实方面对不可行计算）。为此，论文提出了全新的“证明者-估计者辩论”协议，在稳定性假设下消除了这种计算不对等，为复杂AI任务的人类监督提供了更可靠的理论保障。
AI.keywords: AI辩论, 可扩展监督, 递归辩论, 混淆论点, 计算复杂性
AI.comments: 创新性：本文针对AI对齐领域中“可扩展监督”的递归辩论机制进行了理论创新，解决了非诚实方通过构造混淆论点造成计算不对等的问题；重要性：对利用AI辩论（AI Debate）提升人类监督复杂AI行为的能力具有重要理论贡献；局限性：该协议依赖于一定的“稳定性假设”（stability assumptions），在现实应用中的鲁棒性和具体落地效果仍需进一步验证。

title: OrbitAll: A Unified Quantum Mechanical Representation Deep Learning Framework for All Molecular Systems
summary: We introduce OrbitAll, a geometry- and physics-informed deep learning framework that encodes any molecular system with arbitrary charges, spins, and environmental effects using electronic structure information. It utilizes spin-polarized orbital features from the underlying quantum mechanical method and combines them with SE(3)-equivariant graph neural networks. OrbitAll demonstrates superior performance and generalization in predicting charged, open-shell, and solvated molecules, and robustly extrapolates to molecules significantly larger than the training data. OrbitAll achieves chemical accuracy using 10 times fewer training data than competing AI models, with approximately $10^3$ - $10^4$ speedup compared to density functional theory. Trained on a chemically diverse dataset, OrbitAll performs robustly on challenging molecular systems, and outperforms the foundational machine-learned interatomic potential, UMA, for highly charged species, despite using 35 times less molecular data and a 50-times-smaller model. After learning solvent effects, it accurately predicts solvent-dependent reaction pathways at about 100 times lower cost than explicit-solvation simulations using UMA.

AI.title_translation: OrbitAll：适用于所有分子系统的统一量子力学表示深度学习框架
AI.tldr: OrbitAll通过结合量子力学自旋极化轨道特征与SE(3)等变图神经网络，高效且精准地实现了带电、开壳层及溶剂化等各类复杂分子体系的统一建模。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习模型在处理包含任意电荷、开壳层自旋态及复杂环境效应（如溶剂化）的分子系统时存在泛化瓶颈，且往往需要庞大的数据集和计算资源。
AI.method: 将来自底层量子力学方法的自旋极化轨道特征（spin-polarized orbital features）与SE(3)等变图神经网络（SE(3)-equivariant graph neural networks）结合，构建包含几何与物理信息的统一编码框架。
AI.result:
1. 仅需竞争模型 1/10 的训练数据即可达到化学精度，计算速度比密度泛函理论（DFT）提升 $10^3$ - $10^4$ 倍；
2. 在高带电物种预测上，以少 35 倍的数据和小 50 倍的模型超越了基础模型 UMA；
3. 预测依赖溶剂的反应路径时，计算成本比使用 UMA 的显式溶剂化模拟低约 100 倍，且能鲁棒地外推至远大于训练集的分子。
AI.conclusion: OrbitAll是一种高效、准确且具备强泛化能力的统一分子深度学习框架，成功解决了复杂电子态（带电、开壳层）及环境效应下的分子系统建模难题。
AI.translation: 我们推出了 OrbitAll，这是一个结合几何与物理信息的深度学习框架，利用电子结构信息编码任何具有任意电荷、自旋和环境效应的分子系统。它利用来自底层量子力学方法的自旋极化轨道特征，并将其与 SE(3) 等变图神经网络相结合。OrbitAll 在预测带电、开壳层和溶剂化分子方面展示出优异的性能和泛化能力，并能鲁棒地外推到比训练数据大得多的分子。OrbitAll 使用比竞争 AI 模型少 10 倍的训练数据即可达到化学精度，与密度泛函理论（DFT）相比，速度提高了约 $10^3$ 到 $10^4$ 倍。在一个化学多样化的数据集上训练后，OrbitAll 在具有挑战性的分子系统上表现鲁棒；尽管使用的分子数据少了 35 倍且模型小了 50 倍，但在高带电物种上的表现仍优于基础机器学习间原子势模型 UMA。在学习了溶剂效应后，它能够准确预测依赖溶剂的反应路径，其成本比使用 UMA 的显式溶剂化模拟低约 100 倍。
AI.summary: 本文提出了OrbitAll，一种结合几何与物理信息的统一深度学习框架，用于编码包含任意电荷、自旋和环境效应的分子系统。OrbitAll融合了自旋极化轨道特征与SE(3)等变图神经网络，在预测带电、开壳层和溶剂化分子方面表现卓越。该模型不仅数据效率高、计算速度比DFT快数个数量级，而且在远小于现有大模型（如UMA）的参数量下取得了更优的准确率与泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 深度学习, 量子力学表示, SE(3)等变图神经网络, 电子结构, 溶剂化效应
AI.comments: OrbitAll的创新之处在于将量子力学中的电子结构信息（自旋极化轨道特征）融合到SE(3)等变图神经网络中，从根本上增强了物理可解释性与对复杂电子态（如不同电荷、自旋态及溶剂化效应）的表征能力。该框架在极小模型体积和较少训练数据下取得了超越现有大模型的性能，显示出量子物理启发深度学习的巨大潜力。

title: Counterfactual Reasoning and Environment Design for Active Preference Learning
comments: RSS 2025 Workshop on Human-in-the-Loop Robot Learning: Teaching, Correcting, and Adapting
summary: For effective real-world deployment, robots should adapt to human preferences, such as balancing distance, time, and safety in delivery routing. Active preference learning (APL) learns human reward functions by presenting trajectories for ranking. However, existing methods often struggle to explore the full trajectory space and fail to identify informative queries, particularly in long-horizon tasks. We propose CRED, a trajectory generation method for APL that improves reward estimation by jointly optimizing environment design and trajectory selection. CRED "imagines" new scenarios through environment design and uses counterfactual reasoning -- by sampling rewards from its current belief and asking "What if this reward were the true preference?" -- to generate a diverse and informative set of trajectories for ranking. Experiments in GridWorld and real-world navigation using OpenStreetMap data show that CRED improves reward learning and generalizes effectively across different environments.
comment: RSS 2025 Workshop on Human-in-the-Loop Robot Learning: Teaching, Correcting, and Adapting

AI.title_translation: 主动偏好学习中的反事实推理与环境设计
AI.tldr: CRED通过结合环境设计与反事实推理生成高信息量轨迹，显著提升了主动偏好学习中的奖励估算能力与跨环境泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的主动偏好学习（APL）方法在探索完整轨迹空间和识别高信息量查询方面存在困难，尤其是在长航程（long-horizon）任务中难以有效学习人类的奖励函数。
AI.method: 提出了CRED方法，通过联合优化环境设计和轨迹选择来改进奖励估计。CRED通过环境设计“想象”新场景，并运用反事实推理（从当前信念中采样奖励并假设“若该奖励为真实偏好会如何”），生成一套多样化且高信息量的轨迹供人类排序。
AI.result: 在GridWorld和使用OpenStreetMap数据的真实导航实验中，CRED显著提升了奖励学习效果，并在不同环境之间展现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: CRED通过联合优化环境设计与反事实推理，成功解决了传统主动偏好学习在轨迹探索和查询质量上的不足，显著改善了奖励估算效果与跨环境泛化性能。
AI.translation: 为了在现实世界中有效部署，机器人应该适应人类的偏好，例如在配送路径规划中平衡距离、时间和安全性。主动偏好学习（APL）通过呈现轨迹供人类排序来学习人类的奖励函数。然而，现有的方法往往难以探索完整的轨迹空间，且无法识别出高信息量的查询，特别是在长航程任务中。我们提出了CRED，这是一种用于APL的轨迹生成方法，通过联合优化环境设计和轨迹选择来改进奖励估计。CRED通过环境设计“想象”新场景，并使用反事实推理——即从当前信念中采样奖励并询问“如果这个奖励是真实的偏好会怎样？”——来生成用于排序的多样化且富含信息的轨迹集合。在GridWorld以及使用OpenStreetMap数据的真实导航实验表明，CRED提升了奖励学习效果，并能在不同环境之间进行有效泛化。
AI.summary: 针对主动偏好学习在长航程任务中难以充分探索轨迹空间的问题，本文提出CRED方法。该方法结合环境设计与反事实推理，通过“想象”新场景并反事实采样偏好，联合生成高信息量且多样化的轨迹查询，从而显著提升了机器人对人类偏好奖励函数的估计能力与泛化表现。
AI.keywords: 主动偏好学习 (Active Preference Learning), 反事实推理 (Counterfactual Reasoning), 环境设计 (Environment Design), 奖励学习 (Reward Learning), 轨迹生成 (Trajectory Generation)
AI.comments: 本文创新性地将环境设计与反事实推理引入主动偏好学习，打破了在固定或已有环境中生成轨迹查询的局限。在OpenStreetMap真实导航数据上的实验进一步验证了其在复杂、长航程任务中的实际应用价值和泛化能力。潜在局限在于在复杂高维环境中进行环境设计和反事实采样的计算开销可能较高。

title: A Novel Hybrid Deep Learning Technique for Speech Emotion Detection using Feature Engineering
summary: Nowadays, speech emotion recognition (SER) plays a vital role in the field of human-computer interaction (HCI) and the evolution of artificial intelligence (AI). Our proposed DCRF-BiLSTM model is used to recognize seven emotions: neutral, happy, sad, angry, fear, disgust, and surprise, which are trained on five datasets: RAVDESS (R), TESS (T), SAVEE (S), EmoDB (E), and Crema-D (C). The model achieves high accuracy on individual datasets, including 97.83% on RAVDESS, 97.02% on SAVEE, 95.10% for CREMA-D, and a perfect 100% on both TESS and EMO-DB. For the combined (R+T+S) datasets, it achieves 98.82% accuracy, outperforming previously reported results. To our knowledge, no existing study has evaluated a single SER model across all five benchmark datasets (i.e., R+T+S+C+E) simultaneously. In our work, we introduce this comprehensive combination and achieve a remarkable overall accuracy of 93.76%. These results confirm the robustness and generalizability of our DCRF-BiLSTM framework across diverse datasets.

AI.title_translation: 基于特征工程的语音情感检测新型混合深度学习技术
AI.tldr: DCRF-BiLSTM模型在五个基准数据集上实现了高精度的语音情感识别，尤其是在综合数据集上表现出色，达到93.76%的总准确率。
AI.motivation: 语音情感识别（SER）在人机交互（HCI）和人工智能（AI）发展中扮演着重要角色。
AI.method: 提出DCRF-BiLSTM模型，用于识别中性、高兴、悲伤、愤怒、恐惧、厌恶和惊讶七种情感。模型在RAVDESS、TESS、SAVEE、EmoDB和Crema-D五个数据集上进行训练和评估，并引入了对所有五个基准数据集（R+T+S+C+E）同时评估单个SER模型的综合组合。
AI.result: 模型在RAVDESS上达到97.83%，SAVEE上97.02%，CREMA-D上95.10%，TESS和EMO-DB上100%。在组合数据集（R+T+S）上达到98.82%。在所有五个基准数据集（R+T+S+C+E）的综合组合上，实现了93.76%的总准确率。
AI.conclusion: DCRF-BiLSTM框架在不同数据集上表现出鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.translation: 如今，语音情感识别（SER）在人机交互（HCI）和人工智能（AI）领域中扮演着至关重要的角色。我们提出的DCRF-BiLSTM模型用于识别七种情感：中性、高兴、悲伤、愤怒、恐惧、厌恶和惊讶，该模型在五个数据集上进行训练：RAVDESS（R）、TESS（T）、SAVEE（S）、EmoDB（E）和Crema-D（C）。该模型在各个数据集上取得了高准确率，包括RAVDESS上97.83%，SAVEE上97.02%，CREMA-D上95.10%，以及TESS和EMO-DB上完美的100%。对于组合数据集（R+T+S），它达到了98.82%的准确率，超过了之前报告的结果。据我们所知，目前没有研究同时评估一个SER模型在所有五个基准数据集（即R+T+S+C+E）上的表现。在我们的工作中，我们引入了这种全面的组合，并取得了93.76%的显著总准确率。这些结果证实了我们的DCRF-BiLSTM框架在不同数据集上的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.summary: 这篇论文提出了一种名为DCRF-BiLSTM的新型混合深度学习技术，用于语音情感识别。该模型能够识别七种基本情感，并在RAVDESS、TESS、SAVEE、EmoDB和Crema-D五个独立及组合数据集上进行了广泛评估。特别地，该研究首次在一个SER模型上同时评估了所有五个基准数据集的组合，并取得了93.76%的总准确率，证明了其在不同数据集上的鲁棒性和泛化能力，超越了现有成果。
AI.keywords: 语音情感识别, 深度学习, DCRF-BiLSTM, 特征工程, 人机交互
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于首次将单个语音情感识别模型在所有五个主要基准数据集上进行综合评估，并取得了高准确率。这对于验证模型的泛化能力和鲁士性具有重要意义，为未来的SER研究提供了新的基准。

title: Toward Adaptable Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning: An Assumption-Aware Review
summary: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) has achieved strong performance in simulated benchmarks, yet real deployments often violate the assumptions under which algorithms are designed and evaluated. Agent populations may change, objectives may shift, centralized information may be unavailable, execution may become asynchronous, and partner policies may be unfamiliar. Existing surveys discuss related desiderata such as scalability, robustness, generalization, and transferability, but these terms often refer to different objects of analysis and different kinds of distributional or structural shift. This survey proposes \textit{adaptability} as an assumption-aware taxonomy for organizing these shifts, rather than as a universal requirement that every MARL algorithm should succeed in every setting. We distinguish three dimensions: \textit{learning adaptability}, which concerns the applicability of learning paradigms under changed training or system assumptions; \textit{policy adaptability}, which concerns the reuse or adaptation of learned policies under deployment-time changes; and \textit{scenario-driven adaptability}, which concerns whether benchmarks and evaluation protocols expose controlled, diagnostically useful shifts. By separating what changes, when the change occurs, what adaptation is allowed, and what success means, the framework clarifies how established concepts fit together and identifies where current MARL evaluation remains underspecified.

AI.title_translation: 迈向可适应的多智能体强化学习：一项面向假设的综述
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为“适应性”的MARL分类框架，通过区分学习适应性、策略适应性和场景驱动适应性三个维度，解决了现有MARL算法在实际部署中频繁违反设计假设的痛点。
AI.motivation: 现有的多智能体强化学习（MARL）算法在模拟基准中表现出色，但实际部署时常违反其设计假设（如智能体群体变化、目标转移、中心化信息缺失、异步执行及陌生队友等），而现有综述缺乏统一的分类视角来厘清不同的分布与结构偏移。
AI.method: 提出了一种以“适应性”为核心的、面向假设的分类框架，将适应性划分为学习适应性、策略适应性和场景驱动适应性三个维度，并厘清了变化内容、变化时间、允许的适应方式及成功标准的定义。
AI.result: 构建了一个清晰的MARL适应性框架，将学习适应性、策略适应性和场景驱动适应性三个维度系统整合，澄清了现有概念的内在联系，并指出了当前MARL评估中缺乏明确规范的地方。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入基于假设的适应性分类法，本文系统梳理了MARL中的各类分布和结构偏移问题，指出了当前算法评估中存在的不足，为实现真正具备适应能力的MARL指明了方向。
AI.translation: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）在模拟基准测试中取得了优异的性能，然而实际部署往往违反了算法设计和评估所依赖的假设。智能体群体可能会发生变化、目标可能会转移、集中式信息可能不可用、执行可能变得异步，且同伴策略可能不熟悉。现有的综述讨论了诸如可扩展性、鲁棒性、泛化性和可迁移性等相关诉求，但这些术语通常指代不同的分析对象以及不同种类的分布或结构偏移。本综述提出了将“适应性”作为组织这些偏移的面向假设的分类法，而不是将其作为每个MARL算法都应在各种环境中成功的通用要求。我们区分了三个维度：学习适应性，关注学习范式在训练或系统假设改变时的适用性；策略适应性，关注在部署时变化下已学策略的重用或调整；以及场景驱动适应性，关注基准测试和评估协议是否暴露出受控的、具有诊断价值的偏移。通过将变化内容、变化发生时间、允许何种适应以及成功意味着什么进行区分，该框架阐明了既定概念如何契合在一起，并指出了当前MARL评估中仍然规范不足的地方。
AI.summary: 本文针对多智能体强化学习（MARL）中实际部署常违反设计假设的问题，提出了一种名为“适应性”的面向假设的分类法。通过划分学习适应性、策略适应性和场景驱动适应性三个维度，系统梳理了不同类型的分布和结构偏移，澄清了相关概念并揭示了现有评估体系的不足。
AI.keywords: 多智能体强化学习, 适应性, 分类法, 策略泛化, 系统假设
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种面向假设的多智能体强化学习（MARL）适应性分类法，对理解当前MARL在应对环境与系统变化时的局限性具有重要指导意义，有助于规范未来的基准测试和算法评估。

title: Strategies to manage human factors in mixed reality helicopter pilot training: a systematic literature review
summary: Introduction: Mixed reality (MR) head-mounted displays (HMDs) may offer a cost-efficient, immersive alternative to conventional flight simulation displays, but cybersickness, visual fatigue, and ergonomic strain may impair performance and training effectiveness in safety-critical aviation. Methods: We conducted a PRISMA-based systematic review of 80 sources on human factors associated with MR/virtual reality (VR) HMD use in pilot training and analogous safety-critical simulations. Drivers and mitigation strategies were organized into a dual-taxonomy, with strategies classified as hardware, software, ergonomic, physiological, or psychological. Viability was assessed against operational needs and aviation authority expectations. Results: Cybersickness, visual strain, musculoskeletal fatigue, and sensory conflict were the most consistently reported issues. Strategies that preserved simulator fidelity, including high-quality HMD selection, calibration, ergonomic setup, and structured onboarding, appeared more operationally suitable than techniques that reduced realism or visual continuity, such as field-of-view restriction. Risk-of-bias appraisal identified recurring limitations, including convenience sampling, heterogeneous designs, and limited preregistration, which reduced confidence in generalizability. Discussion: Human factors remain a major barrier to MR HMD adoption in pilot training, while operational and regulatory constraints determine which mitigations are feasible. Although the evidence is largely VR-derived, many findings may transfer to MR because both technologies share perceptual and ergonomic mechanisms. The review offers practical guidance for improving comfort and safety without compromising simulator fidelity.

title: Distribution Control of Stochastic Oscillators via Periodic Feedforward and Population-Level Feedback
summary: We address the problem of steering the phase distribution of oscillators all receiving the same control input to a given target distribution. In a large population limit, the distribution of oscillators can be described by a probability density. Thus, we formulate the problem as distribution control over a Fokker--Planck equation. In particular, we consider the case where oscillators are subject to stochastic noise, for which the theoretical understanding is still lacking. First, we characterize the asymptotic reachability of the phase distribution under periodic feedforward control via the Fourier coefficients of the target density and the phase sensitivity function of oscillators. This enables us to design a periodic input that makes the stationary distribution of oscillators closest to the target by solving a convex optimization problem. Next, we devise a distribution controller combining periodic and population-level feedback control, where the feedback component is designed to accelerate the convergence of the distribution of oscillators. We exhibit some convergence results for the proposed method, including a result that holds even under measurement errors in the phase distribution. The effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated by a numerical example.

title: WiRM: Wireless Respiration Monitoring Using Conjugate Multiple Channel State Information and Fast Iterative Filtering in Wi-Fi Systems
summary: Monitoring respiratory health with the use of channel state information (CSI) has shown promising results. Many existing methods focus on monitoring only the respiratory rate, while others focus on monitoring the motion of the chest as a patient breathes, which is referred to as the respiratory waveform. This paper presents WiRM, a two-staged approach to contactless respiration monitoring. In the first stage, WiRM improves upon existing respiratory rate estimation techniques by using conjugate multiplication for phase sanitisation and the adaptive multi-trace carving (AMTC) algorithm for tracing how the respiratory rate changes over time. When compared against four state-of-the-art methods, WiRM has achieved an average reduction of 34.7% in respiratory rate root mean squared error (RMSE). In the second stage, WiRM uses this improved respiratory rate estimate to inform the decomposition and selection of the respiratory waveform from the CSI data. WiRM delivers a 7.9% improvement in average absolute correlation with the ground truth respiratory waveform. Within the literature, it is difficult to compare the robustness of existing algorithms in noisy environments. In this paper, we develop a purpose-built simulation toolkit to evaluate the robustness of respiration monitoring solutions under ambient motion interference and various noise conditions, including thermal, multiplicative, and phase noise. Our results show that WiRM demonstrates improved or comparable resilience to these common noise sources and interference scenario.

title: NeuCoReClass AD: Redefining Self-Supervised Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time series anomaly detection plays a critical role in a wide range of real-world applications. Among unsupervised approaches, self-supervised learning has gained traction for modeling normal behavior without the need of labeled data. However, many existing methods rely on a single proxy task, limiting their ability to capture meaningful patterns in normal data. Moreover, they often depend on handcrafted transformations tailored specific domains, hindering their generalization accross diverse problems. To address these limitations, we introduce NeuCoReClass AD, a self-supervised multi-task time series anomaly detection framework that combines contrastive, reconstruction, and classification proxy tasks. Our method employs neural transformation learning to generate augmented views that are informative, diverse, and coherent, without requiring domain-specific knowledge. We evaluate NeuCoReClass AD across a wide range of benchmarks, demonstrating that it consistently outperforms both classical baselines and most deep-learning alternatives. Furthermore, it enables the characterization of distinct anomaly profiles in a fully unsupervised manner.

title: STEMTOX: From Collaborative Tags to Fine-Grained Toxic Meme Detection via Entropy-Guided Multi-Task Learning
summary: Memes, as a widely used mode of online communication, often serve as vehicles for spreading harmful content. However, limitations in data accessibility and the high costs of dataset curation hinder the development of robust meme moderation systems. To address this challenge, in this work, we introduce a first-of-its-kind dataset - TOXICTAGS consisting of 6,300 real-world meme-based posts annotated in two stages: (i) binary classification into toxic and normal, and (ii) fine-grained labelling of toxic memes as hateful, dangerous, or offensive. A key feature of this dataset is that it includes collaborative tags associated with the original posts, enhancing the context of each meme. In addition, we propose a novel entropy-guided multi-tasking framework -- STEMTOX -- that leverages these collaborative tags alongside visual and textual inputs within a robust classification framework. Experimental results show that incorporating these tags substantially enhances the performance of state-of-the-art VLMs in toxicity detection tasks. Our contributions offer a novel and scalable foundation for improved content moderation in multimodal online environments. Warning: Contains potentially toxic contents.

AI.title_translation: STEMTOX：从协同标签到基于熵引导多任务学习的细粒度有毒Meme检测
AI.tldr: 本文推出了包含协同标签的TOXICTAGS数据集，并提出了STEMTOX框架，利用熵引导的多任务学习和多模态信息显著提升了有毒Meme的检测能力。
AI.motivation: Meme（模因/网络表情包）常被用作传播有害内容的载体，但由于数据可获取性受限以及数据集中标注成本高昂，阻碍了稳健的Meme内容审核系统的开发。
AI.method:
1. 构建了包含6,300个真实Meme帖子的TOXICTAGS数据集，标注分为两阶段（二分类毒性检测，以及仇恨、危险、攻击性等细粒度分类），并保留了原帖的协同标签以补充上下文信息。
2. 提出了基于熵引导的多任务学习框架STEMTOX，结合视觉、文本及协同标签等多模态输入进行稳健的毒性分类。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，引入协同标签能够显著提升现有的最先进视觉语言模型（VLM）在毒性检测任务上的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究做出的贡献为改善多模态网络环境下的内容审核与治理提供了一个具有创新性和可拓展性的坚实基础。
AI.translation: Meme（网络模因/表情包）作为一种广泛使用的网络交流方式，常被用作传播有害内容的载体。然而，数据的可获取性限制以及数据集整理的高昂成本阻碍了稳健的Meme审核系统的开发。为了解决这一挑战，我们在本研究中推出了首创的数据集——TOXICTAGS，它由6,300个真实世界的Meme帖子组成，并分两个阶段进行标注：（i）有毒与正常的二分类，以及（ii）将有毒Meme细粒度标注为仇恨、危险或攻击性。该数据集的一个关键特征是包含了与原始帖子关联的协同标签，从而增强了每个Meme的上下文信息。此外，我们提出了一项创新的熵引导多任务处理框架——STEMTOX，它在一个稳健的分类框架中结合了视觉和文本输入以及这些协同标签。实验结果表明，引入这些标签大幅提升了最先进的视觉语言模型（VLM）在毒性检测任务中的性能。我们的贡献为改善多模态在线环境中的内容审核提供了一个创新且具备可扩展性的基础。（警告：可能包含潜在的有毒内容。）
AI.summary: 本文针对多模态网络表情包（Meme）检测数据不足和审核困难的问题，推出了包含6,300个带有协同标签的TOXICTAGS数据集，并提出了融合文本、视觉及标签信息的熵引导多任务学习框架STEMTOX，显著增强了VLM在细粒度有毒Meme检测上的表现。
AI.keywords: Toxic Meme Detection, Collaborative Tags, Entropy-Guided Multi-Task Learning, Multimodal Content Moderation
AI.comments: 创新性：该研究首次将原始帖子中的协同标签（collaborative tags）作为丰富Meme语义上下文的关键特征，并提出熵引导的多任务学习框架（STEMTOX）。重要性：有效解决了Meme审核中数据获取难、标注成本高的问题，为多模态有害内容治理提供了可扩展的新思路。局限性：数据集规模（6,300条）相对有限，且协同标签的质量和可用性高度依赖于原社交平台的生态特征。

title: Label-Noise Resistant Learning via Optimal Brain Damage Masking
summary: Noisy labels are inevitable in real-world multimedia applications. Due to the strong memorization capacity of deep neural networks, these noisy labels cause significant performance degradation. Existing noise-robust methods have mainly focused on robust loss functions and sample selection strategies, with comparatively limited exploration of dynamic architectural adaptation. In this paper, we rethink the role of classifier connectivity under label noise. Intuitively, performance degradation stems from the backpropagation of noisy gradients. Since the final classifier layer acts as the primary gateway for this error propagation, selectively discarding redundant connections can restrict the backpropagation pathways of noisy gradients. Consequently, to identify redundant connections, we leverage the seminal Optimal Brain Damage (OBD) theory from model compression, which posits that parameters causing negligible loss perturbation can be removed. Guided by this principle, we show that masking low-activation edges limits the estimated loss perturbation to preserve the model's fitting capacity, while tightening a derived upper bound on noise-induced gradient error. To bridge this theoretical insight with practical training, we propose a novel Selective Edge Masking (SEM) mechanism for the fully connected (FC) layer to enhance noise robustness. It can adaptively retain critical edges for information propagation while suppressing gradient errors caused by noisy labels. As a plug-and-play component, SEM can be seamlessly integrated into various noise-robust methods. Additionally, we validate SEM's applicability by applying it to the newly emerged Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) employed as a classifier. Extensive evaluations on synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.title_translation: 基于最优大脑损伤掩码的抗标签噪声学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出选择性边掩码（SEM）机制，利用最优大脑损伤理论裁剪分类器中的低激活边，限制噪声梯度的反向传播，实现高性能抗标签噪声学习。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络容易过度拟合真实应用中的噪声标签导致性能下降。现有的抗噪声方法多局限于损失函数和样本筛选，少有关注动态架构调适。由于最终分类器层是噪声梯度反向传播的主要通道，选择性裁撤冗余连接可以从结构上限制噪声梯度的传播路径。
AI.method: 借鉴模型压缩中的最优大脑损伤（OBD）理论，提出选择性边掩码（SEM）机制。通过掩码低激活度边来限制损失扰动并紧致噪声梯度误差上界，从而自适应保留关键信息通道并切断噪声梯度的传播路径。SEM可作为即插即用组件应用于FC层及Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）分类器中。
AI.result: 在合成噪声数据集和真实世界噪声基准上的广泛实验表明，该方法取得了当前最优（SOTA）的性能。
AI.conclusion: 选择性边掩码（SEM）机制能有效阻断噪声梯度的反向传播，在保持模型拟合能力的同时显著提升模型对标签噪声的鲁棒性，且具备出色的泛化性与即插即用能力。
AI.translation: 现实世界的多媒体应用中不可避免地存在噪声标签。由于深度神经网络具有强大的记忆能力，这些噪声标签会导致显著的性能下降。现有的噪声鲁棒方法主要集中在鲁棒损失函数和样本选择策略上，对动态架构调适的探索相对有限。本文重新思考了标签噪声下分类器连接性的作用。直观地说，性能下降源于噪声梯度的反向传播。由于最终的分类器层是该误差传播的主要关口，选择性地丢弃冗余连接可以限制噪声梯度的反向传播路径。因此，为了识别冗余连接，我们借鉴了模型压缩中经典的最优大脑损伤（OBD）理论，该理论假设引起微不足道损失扰动的参数可以被移除。在这一原则指导下，我们证明了掩码低激活边可以在保留模型拟合能力的同时限制估计的损失扰动，并紧致由噪声引起的梯度误差上界。为了将这一理论洞察与实际训练相结合，我们为全连接（FC）层提出了一种新型的选择性边掩码（SEM）机制，以增强噪声鲁棒性。它可以自适应地保留关键边用于信息传播，同时抑制由噪声标签引起的梯度误差。作为即插即用组件，SEM 可以无缝集成到各种噪声鲁棒方法中。此外，我们还将 SEM 应用于最新出现的作为分类器的 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（KAN），验证了其适用性。在合成和真实世界基准上的广泛评估表明，我们的方法达到了当前最优性能。
AI.summary: 针对标签噪声导致的深度学习性能下降问题，本文从网络分类器连接性出发，结合最优大脑损伤（OBD）理论提出了选择性边掩码（SEM）机制。该方法通过掩码低激活冗余边，限制了噪声梯度的反向传播路径，同时保持模型的拟合能力。SEM为即插即用组件，可无缝集成到现有抗噪声框架及新型KAN网络中，实验证实其达到了SOTA性能。
AI.keywords: 标签噪声, 最优大脑损伤, 选择性边掩码, 深度学习鲁棒性, Kolmogorov-Arnold网络
AI.comments: 本文巧妙地将模型压缩中的经典理论（最优大脑损伤 OBD）应用于抗标签噪声学习领域，从网络分类器连接性与梯度反向传播的角度切入，创新性强。提出的选择性边掩码（SEM）具有即插即用的特性，且延伸验证了在最新KAN网络上的适用性，实用价值高。局限性在于仅凭摘要无法评估引入动态掩码机制后对训练计算开销的具体影响。

title: UtterTune: LoRA-Based Target-Language Pronunciation Edit and Control in Multilingual Text-to-Speech
comments: 7 pages. Corrects the accent-correctness evaluation to the crowdsourced listening test (v3 inadvertently reported the earlier author-scored results), and adds a note on the precedence of the proposed token-based pronunciation-control method relative to a subsequent technical report, together with links to the released code, training/evaluation data, LoRA weights, and audio samples
summary: We propose UtterTune, a lightweight method for adapting a multilingual text-to-speech (TTS) system built on a large language model (LLM). It improves control of pronunciation in the target language while preserving performance in the others. Although LLM architectures have enabled TTS models to achieve remarkable naturalness, accurately modeling grapheme-to-phoneme (G2P) mapping and prosody remains challenging, especially when the model omits an explicit G2P module and directly processes minimally encoded text (e.g., byte-pair encoding). UtterTune leverages low-rank adaptation to enable the control of segmental pronunciation and pitch accent at the phoneme level for Japanese speech, the target language in this paper, while maintaining naturalness and speaker similarity in a zero-shot setting. Objective and subjective evaluations confirm its effectiveness.
comment: 7 pages. Corrects the accent-correctness evaluation to the crowdsourced listening test (v3 inadvertently reported the earlier author-scored results), and adds a note on the precedence of the proposed token-based pronunciation-control method relative to a subsequent technical report, together with links to the released code, training/evaluation data, LoRA weights, and audio samples

AI.title_translation: UtterTune：基于LoRA的跨语言语音合成中目标语言发音编辑与控制
AI.tldr: UtterTune利用LoRA在基于LLM的多语言TTS中实现了音素级别的发音和音调精准控制，同时保持了零样本自然度、说话人相似度及其他语言性能。
AI.motivation: 尽管基于LLM架构的TTS模型实现了极高的自然度，但由于很多模型省略了显式的字音转换（G2P）模块而直接处理字节对编码（BPE）等极简文本，导致准确建模G2P映射和韵律控制依然非常困难。此外，还需要在增强目标语言发音控制的同时，避免损害其他语言的生成性能。
AI.method: 提出了轻量级适配方法UtterTune，利用低秩适应（LoRA）对基于大语言模型（LLM）的多语言TTS系统进行参数高效微调，在无需显式G2P模块的情况下，实现对目标语言（如日语）音素级别的发音段（segmental pronunciation）和声调重音（pitch accent）的精确控制。
AI.result: 客观与主观评估证实了UtterTune的有效性：它不仅成功实现了音素级别的发音与音调控制，而且在零样本（zero-shot）设定下保持了很高的语音自然度与说话人相似度，同时保留了模型在其他语言上的性能。
AI.conclusion: UtterTune成功为基于LLM的多语言TTS系统提供了一种轻量且高效的目标语言发音与韵律编辑控制方案，具有极高的实用价值。
AI.translation: 我们提出了UtterTune，一种用于适配基于大语言模型（LLM）构建的多语言文本转语音（TTS）系统的轻量级方法。它改善了对目标语言发音的控制，同时保留了在其他语言中的性能。尽管LLM架构已使TTS模型能够实现出色的自然度，但精确建模字音转换（G2P）映射和韵律仍然具有挑战性，尤其是当模型省略显式G2P模块并直接处理极简编码文本（例如字节对编码）时。UtterTune利用低秩适应（LoRA）实现了对日语（本文的目标语言）音素级别的发音段和高低音重音（pitch accent）的控制，同时在零样本设定下保持了自然度和说话人相似度。客观和主观评估证实了其有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了UtterTune，一种基于LoRA的轻量级多语言LLM-TTS适配方法。该方法解决了无显式G2P模块的LLM-TTS模型难以精准控制发音与韵律的问题，实现了在零样本设定下对目标语言（如日语）音素级发音和高低音重音的精准编辑与控制，同时维持了高度的语音自然度、说话人相似度以及对其他语言的兼容性。
AI.keywords: Multilingual TTS, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), Pronunciation Control, Pitch Accent, Large Language Models
AI.comments:
1. **创新性**：巧妙地将Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning（PEFT）技术LoRA应用于基于LLM的TTS模型中，解决了无显式G2P模块模型在音素级别发音和韵律控制上的难题。
2. **实用价值**：实现了在零样本生成条件下，对目标语言（如日语）的音素发音和高低音重音（pitch accent）进行精准编辑与控制，同时保持了说话人相似度且未破坏多语言通用能力。
3. **局限性**：摘要仅提到以日语作为目标语言进行了验证，对其他声调语言（如汉语）或复杂发音规则语言的推广效果尚需进一步验证。

title: Poisson-Sampled Fréchet Means on Gaussian Information Manifolds
summary: Distribution-valued marks in a spatial network live on a statistical manifold, whereas their sampling locations are governed by stochastic geometry. We develop a rigorous finite-window theory for Fréchet means sampled by a Poisson point process. The population target is the barycenter of the normalized window mark law, avoiding the typically divergent unnormalized objective on the whole space. Conditional on the Poisson count, independently marked points form an ordinary independent sample; this yields an exact zero-truncated Poissonization transform for fixed-sample risks, tails, consistency, and intrinsic central limit theorems. For geodesic-supported marks, we obtain closed-form random-count mean-square errors. For a common spatial random field, the error separates exactly into a correlation floor and a Poisson term, and stationary Gaussian fields satisfy a spatial central limit theorem with variance equal to the integrated field covariance plus a Poisson diagonal contribution. Slivnyak's theorem and Poisson splitting then give valid reduced- and non-reduced Palm laws and exact resampling and thinning formulas; the correlation floor cancels when the retained and full barycenters share the same field realization. The theory is specialized to covariance-varying Gaussian models: the full univariate Fisher--Rao manifold and the affine-invariant manifold of multivariate covariance matrices, including arbitrary noncommuting, spatially heterogeneous covariance laws. The Wasserstein discussion records the correct one-dimensional covariance barycenter and isolates its commuting flat boundary case.

AI.title_translation: 高斯信息流形上泊松采样的 Fréchet 均值
AI.tldr: 本文建立了有限窗口内由泊松点过程采样的流形值数据（高斯信息流形）的 Fréchet 均值估计理论与空间极限定理。
AI.motivation: 空间网络中的分布值标记存在于统计流形上，其采样位置由随机几何支配。在整个空间上未归一化的目标函数通常会发散，因此需要建立有限窗口内由泊松点过程采样的 Fréchet 均值的严谨理论。
AI.method: 提出有限窗口内的泊松点过程采样理论，通过归一化窗口标记法则定义总体重心；利用零截断泊松化变换分析固定样本风险与渐近性质，结合 Slivnyak 定理和泊松分裂（Poisson splitting）推导 Palm 法则及重采样/薄化公式；并推导高斯 Fisher-Rao 流形与仿射不变协方差流形下的闭形式表达式。
AI.result: 对测地线支持的标记获得了随机计数均方误差的闭形式解；空间随机场的误差精确分解为相关基底项和泊松项；平稳高斯场满足空间中心极限定理；在保留与完整重心共享相同场实现时，相关基底项在薄化中可精确抵消。
AI.conclusion: 本文构建了一套在有限窗口内利用泊松点 process 对流形值数据进行 Fréchet 均值估计的严谨理论体系，并成功将其应用于复杂的非交换、空间非均匀高斯协方差流形中。
AI.translation: 空间网络中的分布值标记存在于统计流形上，而它们的采样位置则由随机几何所支配。我们针对由泊松点过程采样的 Fréchet 均值开发了一套严谨的有限窗口理论。总体目标是归一化窗口标记法则的重心，从而避免了全空间上通常发散的未归一化目标。在给定泊松计数的条件下，独立标记点构成普通的独立样本；这为固定样本风险、尾部概率、一致性和内在中心极限定理提供了精确的零截断泊松化变换。对于测地线支持的标记，我们获得了随机计数均方误差的闭形式解。对于常见的空间随机场，误差精确分解为一个相关基底（correlation floor）和一个泊松项，且平稳高斯场满足空间中心极限定理，其方差等于积分场协方差加上泊松对角贡献。Slivnyak 定理和泊松分裂随后给出了有效的简化与非简化 Palm 法则以及精确的重采样和薄化公式；当保留的重心与完整的重心共享相同的场实现时，相关基底会相互抵消。该理论被专门应用于协方差变化的高斯模型：全单变量 Fisher-Rao 流形和多变量协方差矩阵的仿射不变流形，包括任意非交换的、空间异质的协方差法则。关于 Wasserstein 的讨论记录了正确的一维协方差重心，并孤立了其可交换平坦边界情况。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了高斯信息流形上基于泊松点过程采样的 Fréchet 均值理论。作者提出了有限窗口下的归一化重心目标，利用零截断泊松化变换建立了风险 bound 与渐近极限定理，并将该理论应用于一维 Fisher-Rao 流形、多维仿射不变协方差矩阵流形及 Wasserstein 空间，给出了精细的误差分解与重采样性质。
AI.keywords: Fréchet 均值, 泊松点过程, 高斯信息流形, 统计流形, 空间随机过程
AI.comments: 该论文创新地将随机几何（泊松点过程）与黎曼几何/高斯信息流形上的 Fréchet 均值相结合，解决了无限空间上未归一化目标函数发散的问题。其推导出的均方误差分离公式（相关基底+泊松项）以及薄化/重采样下的误差抵消性质，在空间统计与流形几何的交叉领域具有重要理论意义。

title: A Flexible Design for Beam Squint Effect Suppression in IRS-Aided THz Communications
comments: 5 pages, 3 figures, accepted by IEEE VTC2025-Fall
summary: In this paper, we study employing movable components on both base station (BS) and intelligent reflecting surface (IRS) in a wideband terahertz (THz) multiple-input-single-output (MISO) system, where the BS is equipped with a movable antenna (MA) array and the IRS consists of movable subarrays. To alleviate double beam squint effect caused by the coupling of beam squint at the BS and IRS, we propose to maximize the minimal received power across a wide THz spectrum by delicately configuring the positions of MAs and IRS subarrays, which is highly challenging. By adopting majorization-minimization (MM) methodology, we develop an algorithm to tackle the aforementioned optimization. Numerical results demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed algorithm and the benefit of utilizing movable components on the BS and IRS to mitigate double beam squint effect in wideband THz communications.
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, accepted by IEEE VTC2025-Fall

AI.title_translation: 智能反射面辅助太赫兹通信中抑制斜视效应的灵活设计
AI.tldr: 本文提出在基站和IRS端采用可移动组件并结合MM优化算法，以有效抑制宽带太赫兹通信中的双重波束斜视效应。
AI.motivation: 在宽带太赫兹通信中，基站和IRS两端的波束斜视效应耦合会导致严重的“双重波束斜视效应”，使宽带信号接收功率显著衰减，亟需有效的抑制方案。
AI.method: 在基站侧配置可移动天线（MA）阵列，在IRS侧配置可移动子阵列；构建以最大化宽带频段内最小接收功率为目标的位置配置优化问题，并利用主化-最小化（MM）方法设计算法进行高效求解。
AI.result: 仿真结果验证了所提MM算法的有效性，证明了在基站和IRS采用可移动组件能够显著减轻双重波束斜视效应并提升宽带接收功率。
AI.conclusion: 在基站和IRS端部署并优化配置可移动组件，能够有效抑制宽带太赫兹通信中的双重波束斜视效应，提升系统在宽带频段内的信号接收质量。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们研究了在宽带太赫兹（THz）多输入单输出（MISO）系统中，在基站（BS）和智能反射面（IRS）上同时采用可移动组件的情形，其中基站配备可移动天线（MA）阵列，IRS由可移动子阵列组成。为了缓解由于基站和IRS处的波束斜视耦合所引起的双重波束斜视效应，我们提出通过精细配置MA和IRS子阵列的位置来最大化宽太赫兹频谱上的最小接收功率，这是一个极具挑战性的优化问题。通过采用主化-最小化（MM）方法，我们开发了一套算法来解决上述优化问题。数值结果证实了我们所提算法的有效性，并展示了在基站和IRS上利用可移动组件来减轻宽带太赫兹通信中双重波束斜视效应的显著益处。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种在智能反射面（IRS）辅助的宽带太赫兹通信系统中抑制双重波束斜视效应的灵活设计方案。通过在基站引入可移动天线阵列、在IRS引入可移动子阵列，并应用主化-最小化（MM）算法联合优化其位置，实现了整个宽带频谱上最小接收功率的最大化，有效提升了系统的传输性能。
AI.keywords: 智能反射面, 太赫兹通信, 波束斜视效应, 可移动天线, 主化-最小化算法
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将可移动天线（MA）与智能反射面（IRS）的可移动子阵列机制相结合，从收发两端协同解决宽带太赫兹通信中棘手的“双重波束斜视”问题。所提出的基于MM方法的优化算法展现了较好的理论完备性。局限性在于摘要未提及实际硬件实现的复杂度以及信道状态信息（CSI）获取开销。

title: FlexNGIA 2.0: Redesigning the Internet with Agentic AI -- Protocols, Services, and Traffic Engineering Designed, Deployed, and Managed by AI
summary:
The escalating demands of immersive communications, alongside advances in network softwarization and AI-driven cognition and generative reasoning, create a pivotal opportunity to rethink and reshape the future Internet. In this context, we introduce in this paper, FlexNGIA 2.0, an Agentic AI-driven Internet architecture that leverages LLM-based AI agents to autonomously orchestrate, configure, and evolve the network. These agents can, at runtime, perceive, reason, coordinate among themselves to dynamically design, implement, deploy, and adapt communication protocols, Service Function Chains (SFCs), network functions, resource allocation strategies, congestion control, and traffic engineering schemes, thereby ensuring optimal performance, reliability, and efficiency under evolving conditions.
  The paper first outlines the overall architecture of FlexNGIA 2.0 and its constituent LLM-Based AI agents. For each agent, we detail its design, implementation, inputs and outputs, prompt structures, interactions with tools and other agents, followed by preliminary proof-of-concept experiments demonstrating its operation and potential. The results clearly highlight the ability of these LLM-based AI agents to automate the design, the implementation, the deployment, and the performance evaluation of transport protocols, service function chains, network functions, congestion control schemes, and resource allocation strategies.
  FlexNGIA 2.0 paves the way for a new class of Agentic AI-Driven networks, where fully cognitive, self-evolving AI agents can autonomously design, implement, adapt and optimize the network's protocols, algorithms, and behaviors to efficiently operate across complex, dynamic, and heterogeneous environments. To bring this vision to reality, we also identify key research challenges toward achieving fully autonomous, adaptive, and agentic AI-driven networks.

AI.title_translation: FlexNGIA 2.0：通过智能体AI重构互联网——由AI设计、部署和管理的协议、服务与流量工程
AI.tldr: FlexNGIA 2.0利用基于大语言模型的智能体AI自主设计、部署和管理互联网协议、服务和流量工程。
AI.motivation: 沉浸式通信日益增长的需求，结合网络软件化以及AI驱动的认知与生成式推理技术的进步，为重新思考和重塑未来互联网架构提供了关键契机。
AI.method: 提出了FlexNGIA 2.0架构，利用基于大语言模型（LLM）的AI智能体，详细设计了各个智能体的输入输出、提示词结构、工具与智能体间交互方式，使智能体能够在运行时进行感知、推理与协作，动态设计、部署和优化网络协议、服务功能链（SFC）、网络功能及资源分配策略。
AI.result: 初步概念验证实验表明，基于LLM的AI智能体能够成功实现传输协议、服务功能链、网络功能、拥塞控制方案和资源分配策略的自动化设计、实现、部署及性能评估。
AI.conclusion: FlexNGIA 2.0为完全认知、自演化的智能体AI驱动网络奠定了基础，使其能在复杂、动态和异构的环境中自主优化网络行为，同时论文指出了实现全自主网络面临的关键研究挑战。
AI.translation:
沉浸式通信日益增长的需求，结合网络软件化以及AI驱动的认知和生成式推理的进步，为重新思考和重塑未来互联网创造了关键契机。在此背景下，本文介绍了 FlexNGIA 2.0，这是一种基于智能体AI驱动的互联网架构，利用基于大语言模型（LLM）的AI智能体来自主编排、配置和演化网络。这些智能体可以在运行时感知、推理并相互协调，从而动态地设计、实现、部署和适应通信协议、服务功能链（SFC）、网络功能、资源分配策略、拥塞控制和流量工程方案，从而确保在不断变化条件下的最佳性能、可靠性和效率。
本文首先概述了 FlexNGIA 2.0 的整体架构及其组成的基于 LLM 的 AI 智能体。对于每个智能体，我们详细介绍了其设计、实现、输入和输出、提示词结构、与工具及其他智能体的交互，随后展示了证明其运行和潜力的初步概念验证实验。结果明确突出了这些基于 LLM 的 AI 智能体在自动化传输协议、服务功能链、网络功能、拥塞控制方案和资源分配策略的设计、实现、部署及性能评估方面的能力。
FlexNGIA 2.0 为一类新型的基于智能体AI驱动的网络铺平了道路，其中完全认知、自演化的 AI 智能体可以自主设计、实现、适应和优化网络的协议、算法和行为，以在复杂、动态和异构的环境中高效运行。为了将这一愿景变为现实，我们还确定了实现完全自主、自适应和智能体AI驱动网络的关键研究挑战。
AI.summary: FlexNGIA 2.0提出了一种基于智能体AI（Agentic AI）驱动的未来互联网架构。该架构利用基于大语言模型（LLM）的AI智能体，在运行时自主感知、推理并相互协调，从而动态设计、实现、部署和优化网络协议、服务功能链（SFC）、网络功能、拥塞控制和流量工程策略。初步概念验证实验表明，LLM智能体能够有效自动化网络各层面的设计与部署，为全认知、自演化的自主网络铺平了道路。
AI.keywords: 智能体AI, 大语言模型, 互联网架构, 服务功能链, 流量工程
AI.comments: 该论文提出了将大语言模型（LLM）与智能体AI（Agentic AI）深度引入计算机网络底层架构（如传输协议、拥塞控制、流量工程等）的前瞻性理念，将AI的角色从传统的辅助决策拓展到网络全生命周期的自动化重构，开辟了自演化网络的新范式。然而，在实际超大规模与极低时延网络环境中，基于LLM的智能体推理时延、确定性容错以及安全性仍是需要进一步解决的关键挑战。

title: On a class of twisted elliptic curve codes
summary: Motivated by the studies of twisted generalized Reed-Solomon (TGRS) codes, we initiate the study of twisted elliptic curve codes (TECCs) in this paper. In particular, we study a class of TECCs with one twist. The parity-check matrices of the TECCs are explicitly given by computing the Weil differentials. Then the sufficient and necessary conditions of self-duality are presented. The minimum distances of the TECCs are also determined. Moreover, examples of MDS, AMDS, self-dual and MDS self-dual TECCs are given. Finally, we calculate the dimensions of the Schur squares of TECCs and show the non-equivalence between TECCs and ECCs/GRS codes.

AI.title_translation: 关于一类扭曲椭圆曲线码
AI.tldr: 本文开启了对扭曲椭圆曲线码（TECCs）的研究，确定了其校验矩阵、自偶性与最小距离，并证明其不同于传统的ECCs和GRS码。
AI.motivation: 受扭曲广义Reed-Solomon（TGRS）码研究的启发，希望将其“扭曲”思想推广到椭圆曲线码（ECCs）中，从而引入并研究扭曲椭圆曲线码（TECCs）。
AI.method: 通过计算Weil微分显式构造包含一个扭曲的TECCs的校验矩阵；推导自偶性的充要条件并确定最小距离；通过计算Schur平方的维数判断编码的等价性。
AI.result: 显式给出了具有一个扭曲的TECCs的校验矩阵、自偶性充要条件及最小距离；提供了MDS、AMDS、自偶及MDS自偶TECCs的具体实例；证明了TECCs与传统ECCs及GRS码之间的非等价性。
AI.conclusion: 扭曲椭圆曲线码是一类具有丰富代数性质（如MDS、自偶性）的新型编码，且结构上独立于传统的椭圆曲线码和GRS码。
AI.translation: 受扭曲广义Reed-Solomon（TGRS）码研究的启发，我们在本文中开启了对扭曲椭圆曲线码（TECCs）的研究。特别地，我们研究了一类带有一个扭曲的TECCs。通过计算Weil微分，显式地给出了TECCs的校验矩阵。随后给出了自偶性的充分必要条件。同时确定了TECCs的最小距离。此外，还给出了MDS、AMDS、自偶以及MDS自偶TECCs的示例。最后，我们计算了TECCs的Schur平方的维数，并证明了TECCs与ECCs/GRS码之间的非等价性。
AI.summary: 本文首次提出了扭曲椭圆曲线码（TECCs），并深入研究了一类具有单扭曲的TECCs。通过Weil微分给出了其校验矩阵，确定了最小距离及自偶性充要条件，构造了MDS和自偶等类型编码示例，并利用Schur平方维数证实了TECCs与传统ECCs/GRS码是不等价的新型编码。
AI.keywords: twisted elliptic curve codes, self-duality, minimum distance, Schur square, MDS codes
AI.comments:
创新性：将TGRS码中的“扭曲”构造成功引入椭圆曲线码中，开辟了代数几何码研究的新方向；
重要性：不仅导出了校验矩阵、最小距离和自偶性条件，还给出了MDS和自偶等关键实例，并通过Schur平方证明了其不同于传统编码的独立价值；
局限性：目前仅研究了一类带有一个扭曲的情况，对于多重扭曲或一般代数曲线码的推广仍有待进一步探讨。

title: Self-Explaining Reinforcement Learning for Mobile Network Resource Allocation
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) methods, though powerful, often lack transparency, which limits their adoption in critical domains. We apply Self-Explaining Neural Networks (SENNs) to RL by parametrizing the policy of a PPO agent with a SENN, producing intrinsic local explanations, and propose a method for aggregating them into global explanations. We evaluate our approach on a mobile network resource allocation problem, our approach performs within a small margin of the state-of-the-art deep learning method and significantly outperforms the best deployed heuristic, while the extracted global explanations correlate strongly with DeepLift and InputXGradient, making SENNs a promising candidate for high-stakes RL.

AI.title_translation: 移动网络资源分配的可自解释强化学习
AI.tldr: 本文将自解释神经网络（SENN）结合到PPO强化学习算法中，在移动网络资源分配中实现了接近最先进模型的性能和极佳的模型透明度。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习（DRL）方法虽然性能强大，但通常缺乏透明度（黑盒问题），从而限制了其在移动网络资源分配等高风险和关键领域的推广应用。
AI.method: 将自解释神经网络（SENN）引入强化学习，通过SENN对PPO智能体的策略进行参数化，从而生成内在的局部解释；同时提出了一种将这些局部解释聚合为全局解释的方法。
AI.result: 在移动网络资源分配问题上的评估显示，该方法的性能与当前最先进的深度学习方法仅有微小差距，且显著优于已部署的最佳启发式方法；同时提取的全局解释与DeepLift和InputXGradient显著相关。
AI.conclusion: SENN能够提供具有高透明度和高可信度的解释，同时保持出色的任务性能，使其成为高风险强化学习应用领域极具前景的候选方案。
AI.translation: 深度强化学习（DRL）方法虽然强大，但通常缺乏透明度，这限制了它们在关键领域的应用。我们将自解释神经网络（SENN）应用于强化学习，通过使用SENN对PPO智能体的策略进行参数化，产生固有的局部解释，并提出了一种将它们聚合为全局解释的方法。我们在移动网络资源分配问题上评估了我们的方法，该方法的性能与最先进的深度学习方法仅有微小差距，且显著优于最佳已部署的启发式方法，同时提取的全局解释与DeepLift和InputXGradient强相关，这使得SENN成为高风险强化学习应用领域中极具前景的候选方案。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于自解释神经网络（SENN）的可解释深度强化学习框架，用其参数化PPO策略，以提供内在的局部与全局解释。在移动网络资源分配任务中的实验表明，该方法在显著超越传统启发式算法的同时，性能接近最先进的黑盒深度学习模型，且解释具备高相关性。
AI.keywords: 深度强化学习, 自解释神经网络, 移动网络, 资源分配, 可解释人工智能
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将自解释神经网络（SENN）与PPO结合，为解决强化学习在关键高风险场景（如移动通信网络资源管理）中的“黑盒”问题提供了有效途径。其优势在于能同时提供内在的局部与全局解释，且性能接近无解释性的深度模型；潜在局限在于在极高维度状态空间下，聚合全局解释的计算复杂度可能会增加。

title: LC-SLab -- An object-based deep learning framework for large-scale land cover classification from satellite imagery and sparse in-situ labels
comments: Accepted for publication in International Journal of Applied Earth Observation and Geoinformation. See 'Related DOI' for the published version
summary: Large-scale land cover maps generated using deep learning play a critical role across a wide range of Earth science applications. Open in-situ datasets from principled land cover surveys offer a scalable alternative to manual annotation for training such models. However, their sparse spatial coverage often leads to fragmented and noisy predictions when used with existing deep learning-based land cover mapping approaches. A promising direction to address this issue is object-based classification, which assigns labels to semantically coherent image regions rather than individual pixels, thereby imposing a minimum mapping unit. Despite this potential, object-based methods remain underexplored in deep learning-based land cover mapping pipelines, especially in the context of medium-resolution imagery and sparse supervision. To address this gap, we propose LC-SLab, the first deep learning framework for systematically exploring object-based deep learning methods for large-scale land cover classification under sparse supervision. LC-SLab supports both input-level aggregation via graph neural networks, and output-level aggregation by postprocessing results from established semantic segmentation models. Additionally, we incorporate features from a large pre-trained network to improve performance on small datasets. We evaluate the framework on annual Sentinel-2 composites with sparse LUCAS labels, focusing on the tradeoff between accuracy and fragmentation, as well as sensitivity to dataset size. Our results show that object-based methods can match or exceed the accuracy of common pixel-wise models while producing substantially more coherent maps. Input-level aggregation proves more robust on smaller datasets, whereas output-level aggregation performs best with more data. Several configurations of LC-SLab also outperform existing land cover products, highlighting the framework's practical utility.
comment: Accepted for publication in International Journal of Applied Earth Observation and Geoinformation. See 'Related DOI' for the published version

AI.title_translation: LC-SLab：一种基于卫星影像与稀疏现场标注的大范围土地覆盖分类对象级深度学习框架
AI.tldr: LC-SLab是一个针对稀疏现场标注的大范围遥感土地覆盖分类框架，通过基于对象（输入级图神经网络与输出级后处理）的深度学习方法，显著降低分类图的碎片化并提升精度。
AI.motivation: 利用开放的原位调查数据训练深度学习土地覆盖分类模型可以减少人工标注成本，但原位数据的空间分布极为稀疏，采用现有的像素级深度学习方法容易导致分类预测结果严重碎化且带有大量噪声。而基于对象的分类方法在此类稀疏监督和中分辨率影像场景中的应用尚未得到系统探索。
AI.method: 提出了LC-SLab框架，包含两种对象级聚合策略：1）基于图神经网络（GNN）的输入级聚合；2）基于传统语义分割模型输出后处理的输出级聚合。此外，框架还集成了大型预训练特征提取网络，以提升在小规模数据集上的分类性能。
AI.result: 在结合LUCAS稀疏标注的Sentinel-2年度合成影像评估中，基于对象的方法在精度上达到或超越了传统的像素级模型，同时生成的土地覆盖图空间连贯性显著增强。输入级聚合在小数据集上更具鲁棒性，而输出级聚合在大数据量下表现最优；多个配置下的性能超越了现有的主流土地覆盖产品。
AI.conclusion: 基于对象的深度学习方法在大规模稀疏监督土地覆盖分类中展现出巨大的实用价值，不仅能保持或提升分类精度，还能大幅提高地图的空间连贯性，为利用开放原位数据进行大范围遥感制图提供了强有力的工具。
AI.translation: 利用深度学习生成的大范围土地覆盖图在各种地球科学应用中发挥着关键作用。来自规范土地覆盖调查的开放现场数据集为训练此类模型提供了一种替代人工标注的可扩展方案。然而，当这些数据集与现有的基于深度学习的土地覆盖制图方法结合使用时，其稀疏的空间覆盖率往往会导致预测结果碎片化且充满噪声。解决该问题的一个有前景的方向是基于对象的分类，它将标签分配给语义一致的图像区域而不是单个像素，从而引入了最小制图单元。尽管具有这种潜力，基于对象的方法在基于深度学习的土地覆盖制图流程中仍缺乏深入探索，特别是在中分辨率影像和稀疏监督的背景下。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了 LC-SLab，这是第一个用于在稀疏监督下系统探索基于对象的深度学习方法进行大范围土地覆盖分类的深度学习框架。LC-SLab 既支持通过图神经网络进行的输入级聚合，也支持通过对成熟语义分割模型的预测结果进行后处理来实现的输出级聚合。此外，我们引入了大预训练网络的特征，以提高在小数据集上的性能。我们在带有稀疏 LUCAS 标签的 Sentinel-2 年度合成图像上评估了该框架，重点关注精度与碎片化之间的权衡，以及对数据集大小的敏感性。我们的结果表明，基于对象的方法可以达到或超过常见像素级模型的精度，同时生成空间连贯性显著增强的地图。输入级聚合在较小的集上表现出更高的鲁棒性，而输出级聚合在数据量更多时表现最佳。LC-SLab 的几种配置也超越了现有的土地覆盖产品，突显了该框架的实用价值。
AI.summary: 本文提出了LC-SLab深度学习框架，首次系统探索了在稀疏监督下基于对象的深度学习大范围土地覆盖分类方法。该框架支持输入级（GNN）和输出级（后处理）两种对象聚合方式，并结合预训练特征。实验表明，该框架不仅显著降低了预测图的碎片化程度、保持或提升了分类精度，还在多种配置下优于现有的土地覆盖产品。
AI.keywords: 土地覆盖分类, 基于对象的深度学习, 稀疏监督, 遥感图像, 空间聚合
AI.comments: 该论文针对基于稀疏现场标注（如LUCAS数据集）进行大面积土地覆盖分类时易产生斑块碎化和噪声的问题，创新性地提出了结合对象级（Object-based）聚合的深度学习框架LC-SLab。其主要贡献在于系统探讨了输入级（GNN）与输出级（后处理）聚合策略在不同数据规模下的适用性，并引入大模型预训练特征提升小样本下的性能。局限性在于针对不同数据规模需要选择不同的聚合策略，且依赖于高质量的对象分割图。

title: SciTrek: Evaluating and Improving Long-Context Numerical Reasoning over Scientific Articles
summary: We introduce SciTrek, a synthetic question-answering dataset for assessing and improving long-context numerical reasoning in large language models (LLMs). Existing long-context datasets with inputs beyond 64K tokens either target simple information retrieval or, when they do involve reasoning, rely on artificial contexts, while numerical reasoning remains largely overlooked in both cases. SciTrek addresses these limitations with questions that require numerical operations (e.g., counting, sorting, aggregation, and comparison) over collections of full-text scientific articles. Questions are generated automatically by formulating them as SQL queries over a database of article metadata (titles, authors, and references), and ground-truth answers are obtained by executing these queries. The underlying SQL provides a transparent, verifiable specification of the reasoning each question requires, enabling fine-grained error analysis, while the fully automated pipeline scales to arbitrary context lengths and dataset sizes with minimal human supervision, mitigating data contamination and supplying abundant data for post-training. Extensive experiments show that frontier open-weight and proprietary LLMs struggle even with ostensibly simple questions: the best-performing model achieves only 46.5% exact match at 128K tokens, and performance degrades steadily as contexts grow. Fine-grained analysis reveals systematic weaknesses on citation-related questions and on compound logical conditions, particularly those involving negation. Finally, post-training open-weight models on SciTrek improves their numerical reasoning in ways that generalise to out-of-domain long-context tasks.

AI.title_translation: SciTrek：评估与提升科学论文上的长上下文数值推理能力
AI.tldr: SciTrek通过SQL查询自动生成基于科学文献的长文本数值推理数据集，揭示了主流大模型在超长上下文数值推理上的严重不足，并证明了后训练对提升模型长文本推理泛化能力的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的长上下文数据集（>64K tokens）大多仅关注简单的检索任务，或在涉及推理时使用人工构建的虚拟语境，导致大语言模型在真实长文本下的数值推理能力缺乏有效评估与提升手段。
AI.method: 通过将问题转化为基于科学论文元数据（标题、作者、参考文献）数据库的SQL查询，自动生成涵盖计数、排序、聚合和比较等数值操作的问题，并执行SQL获取标准答案，构建了完全自动化的长文本数值推理评估与训练数据流水线。
AI.result: 前沿开源与闭源模型在SciTrek上表现普遍不佳，最佳模型在128K token长度下的精确匹配率仅为46.5%，且性能随文本增加而显著下降；模型在处理引用相关问题及包含否定词的复合逻辑条件时存在明显的系统性短板。
AI.conclusion: 利用SciTrek数据集对开源大语言模型进行后训练，不仅能显著提升其在长文本下的数值推理能力，还能有效泛化至域外的长上下文任务。
AI.translation: 我们推出了 SciTrek，这是一个合成问答数据集，用于评估和改进大语言模型（LLM）中的长上下文数值推理能力。现有的超过 64K token 的长上下文数据集要么仅针对简单的信息检索，要么在涉及推理时依赖人工构建的语境，而数值推理在两种情况下很大程度上都被忽视了。SciTrek 通过提出需要对整本科学论文集合进行数值操作（例如计数、排序、聚合和比较）的问题来解决这些局限性。问题是通过将论文元数据（标题、作者和参考文献）数据库构造成 SQL 查询来自动生成的，而真实答案则是通过执行这些查询获得的。底层的 SQL 为每个问题所需的推理提供了透明且可验证的规范，从而能够进行细粒度的错误分析，同时完全自动化的流程可以以极少的人工监督扩展到任意上下文长度和数据集大小，减轻了数据污染并为后训练提供了丰富的数据。广泛的实验表明，前沿的开源和闭源 LLM 即使在看似简单的问题上也表现挣扎：表现最好的模型在 128K token 时仅获得 46.5% 的精确匹配率，并且随着上下文的增加，性能持续下降。细粒度的分析揭示了在引用相关问题和复合逻辑条件（尤其是包含否定句的情况）上的系统性缺陷。最后，在 SciTrek 上对开源模型进行后训练改善了它们的数值推理能力，并且这种改进可以泛化到域外长上下文任务中。
AI.summary: 本文针对大语言模型在长文本下数值推理能力不足的问题，提出了自动生成的合成数据集SciTrek。该数据集基于科学论文元数据并利用SQL查询构建，提供了精确可验证的数值推理问题。评测显示主流模型在长文本数值推理上挑战巨大，而基于SciTrek的后训练可显著增强模型的长文本数值推理能力及其泛化性。
AI.keywords: 长上下文, 数值推理, 大语言模型, 科学文献, 自动化数据集构建
AI.comments: 创新点：巧妙利用SQL查询构建透明、可验证且完全自动化的生成流水线，极大地降低了长文本数据集构建的人工成本并避免了数据污染；重要性：填补了长文本评测中缺乏复杂数值推理任务的空白，并证明了后训练对提升模型泛化数值推理能力的有效性；局限性：问题主要基于论文元数据（标题、作者、引用等）构建，对论文正文内深层次科学概念的逻辑推理覆盖可能有限。

title: On the Separability of Information in Diffusion Models
comments: 30 pages + references, 19 figures. v5: Camera-ready version from ICML 2026
summary: Diffusion models transform noise into data by injecting information that was captured in their neural network during the training phase. In this paper, we ask: \textit{what} is this information? We find that, in pixel-space diffusion models, (1) a large fraction of the total information in the neural network is committed to reconstructing small-scale perceptual details of the image, and (2) the correlations between images and their class labels are informed by the semantic content of the images, and are largely agnostic to the low-level details. We argue that these properties are intrinsically tied to the manifold structure of the data itself. Finally, we show that these facts explain the efficacy of classifier-free guidance: the guidance vector amplifies the mutual information between images and conditioning signals early in the generative process, influencing semantic structure, but tapers out as perceptual details are filled in.
comment: 30 pages + references, 19 figures. v5: Camera-ready version from ICML 2026

AI.title_translation: 论扩散模型中信息的可分离性
AI.tldr: 扩散模型大部分模型容量用于生成微观感知细节，而语义与细节信息是可分离的，这解释了无分类器引导仅在生成早期影响语义结构的机制。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型通过注入训练时捕捉的信息将噪声转化为数据，但这些信息的具体性质尚不明确。本文旨在探究扩散模型中所包含的信息究竟是什么，以及语义信息与低级感知细节是如何表示和分离的。
AI.method: 针对像素空间扩散模型，分析神经网络中不同类型信息（微观感知细节与语义类别标签）的分布与相关性，并研究无分类器引导（CFG）向量在生成全路线中对图像与条件信号间互信息的影响。
AI.result:
1. 神经网络中的大部分总信息被用于重构图像的微观感知细节；
2. 图像与其类别标签之间的相关性由语义内容驱动，且很大程度上独立于低级细节；
3. 无分类器引导（CFG）向量在生成早期放大图像与条件信号之间的互信息以塑造语义结构，而在后续填充感知细节时引导作用逐渐减弱。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型中信息的分离特性与数据的流形结构内在关联，这一规律成功解释了无分类器引导在不同生成阶段的作用机制和有效性。
AI.translation: 扩散模型通过注入训练阶段保存在其神经网络中的信息，将噪声转化为数据。在本文中，我们提出了这样一个问题：这些信息究竟是什么？我们发现，在像素空间扩散模型中，(1) 神经网络中的大部分总信息致力于重构图像的微观感知细节；(2) 图像与其类别标签之间的相关性由图像的语义内容驱动，且在很大程度上独立于低级细节。我们认为这些特性与数据本身的流形结构内在相关。最后，我们表明这些事实解释了无分类器引导（classifier-free guidance）的有效性：引导向量在生成过程的早期放大了图像与条件信号之间的互信息，从而影响语义结构，但在填充感知细节时其作用会逐渐衰减。
AI.summary: 本文研究了像素空间扩散模型中存储的信息性质，发现模型的大部分容量用于重构微观感知细节，而语义类别信息与低级细节相解耦。这一现象由数据的流形结构所决定，并解释了无分类器引导（CFG）的有效性：CFG仅在生成早期通过放大互信息来指导语义结构的生成，而在后期细节填充阶段作用逐渐退化。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 信息可分离性, 无分类器引导, 数据流形, 语义结构
AI.comments: 本文深入探讨了扩散模型生成机制的核心问题——信息如何在神经网络中表示与分离。研究通过揭示像素空间扩散模型中语义与低级细节的解耦特征，不仅为数据流形假设提供了有力支持，更为理解无分类器引导（CFG）的作用时序与机制提供了清晰的直觉与解释，对优化扩散模型的采样效率和引导策略具有重要的理论价值。

title: Toward a Vision-Language Foundation Model for Medical Data: Multimodal Dataset and Benchmarks for Vietnamese PET/CT Report Generation
comments: 39th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2025) Track on Datasets and Benchmarks
summary: Vision-Language Foundation Models (VLMs), trained on large-scale multimodal datasets, have driven significant advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI) by enabling rich cross-modal reasoning. Despite their success in general domains, applying these models to medical imaging remains challenging due to the limited availability of diverse imaging modalities and multilingual clinical data. Most existing medical VLMs are trained on a subset of imaging modalities and focus primarily on high-resource languages, thus limiting their generalizability and clinical utility. To address these limitations, we introduce a novel Vietnamese-language multimodal medical dataset consisting of 2,757 whole-body PET/CT volumes from independent patients and their corresponding full-length clinical reports. This dataset is designed to fill two pressing gaps in medical AI development: (1) the lack of PET/CT imaging data in existing VLMs training corpora, which hinders the development of models capable of handling functional imaging tasks; and (2) the underrepresentation of low-resource languages, particularly the Vietnamese language, in medical vision-language research. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first dataset to provide comprehensive PET/CT-report pairs in Vietnamese. We further introduce a training framework to enhance VLMs' learning, including data augmentation and expert-validated test sets. We conduct comprehensive experiments benchmarking state-of-the-art VLMs on downstream tasks. The experimental results show that incorporating our dataset significantly improves the performance of existing VLMs. We believe this dataset and benchmark will serve as a pivotal step in advancing the development of more robust VLMs for medical imaging, especially for low-resource languages and clinical use in Vietnamese healthcare. The source code is available at https://github.com/AIoT-Lab-BKAI/ViPET-ReportGen.
comment: 39th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2025) Track on Datasets and Benchmarks

AI.title_translation: 迈向医学数据的视觉-语言基础模型：越南语 PET/CT 报告生成的多模态数据集与基准
AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个全身 PET/CT 越南语多模态医学数据集及基准，填补了功能成像与低资源语言在医学视觉-语言模型领域的空白。
AI.motivation: 现有的医学视觉-语言模型多数仅针对特定高资源语言（如英语）和常见成像模态，缺乏包含 PET/CT 等功能成像数据以及低资源语言（如越南语）的多模态临床数据集，限制了模型在复杂模态和特定语言环境下的泛化能力与临床应用价值。
AI.method: 构建了包含 2,757 例全身 PET/CT 体积数据及其对应完整越南语临床报告的多模态数据集；提出了结合数据增强和专家验证测试集的训练框架；并在下游任务上对多种主流 SOTA 视觉-语言模型进行了全面的基准测试。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，将该数据集融入训练过程能够显著提升现有视觉-语言基础模型在医学报告生成等下游任务上的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集和基准为推动医疗成像领域（特别是针对低资源语言和越南医疗临床应用）更稳健的视觉-语言基础模型的发展奠定了关键基础。
AI.translation: 基于大规模多模态数据集训练的视觉-语言基础模型（VLMs）通过实现丰富的跨模态推理，推动了人工智能（AI）领域的显著进步。尽管这些模型在通用领域取得了成功，但由于多样化成像模态和多语言临床数据的可用性有限，将其应用于医学成像仍然面临挑战。绝大多数现有的医学 VLM 仅在成像模态的子集上进行训练，且主要关注高资源语言，从而限制了它们的泛化能力和临床实用性。为了解决这些局限性，我们引入了一个全新的越南语多模态医学数据集，包含来自 2,757 例独立患者的全身 PET/CT 体积数据及其对应的完整临床报告。该数据集旨在填补医学 AI 发展中的两个迫切空白：（1）现有 VLM 训练语料库中缺乏 PET/CT 成像数据，这阻碍了处理功能成像任务模型的发展；（2）低资源语言（尤其是越南语）在医学视觉-语言研究中的代表性不足。据我们所知，这是首个提供完整的越南语 PET/CT-报告对的数据集。我们进一步提出了一个用于提升 VLM 学习能力的训练框架，包括数据增强和经过专家验证的测试集。我们对最新的 VLM 在下游任务上进行了全面的基准测试实验。实验结果表明，融入我们的数据集可显著提高现有 VLM 的性能。我们相信该数据集和基准将成为推动医学成像领域（尤其是低资源语言及越南医疗临床应用）更稳健 VLM 发展的关键一步。源代码已在 https://github.com/AIoT-Lab-BKAI/ViPET-ReportGen 开源。
AI.summary: 本文针对医学视觉-语言模型缺乏 PET/CT 功能成像数据以及低资源语言（越南语）的痛点，提出了首个包含 2,757 例全身 PET/CT 体积及对应完整越南语临床报告的多模态数据集。同时，作者设计了包含数据增强和专家验证集的训练框架，并在下游任务上对主流模型进行了基准测试，结果验证了该数据集对提升模型性能的显著效果。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言模型, PET/CT, 越南语数据集, 医学报告生成, 多模态AI
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地填补了医学视觉-语言基础模型在全身 PET/CT 功能成像模态以及低资源语言（越南语）双重维度的空白，对推动医疗AI的多语言均衡发展和复杂模态应用具有重要价值。局限性在于数据规模（2,757例）相比通用域数据集仍较小，未来可进一步拓展至更多病种和跨语言迁移学习研究。

title: Efficient MPC-Based Energy Management System for Secure and Cost-Effective Microgrid Operations
summary: Model predictive control (MPC)-based energy management systems (EMS) are essential for ensuring optimal, secure, and stable operation in microgrids with high penetrations of distributed energy resources. However, due to the high computational cost for the decision-making, the conventional MPC-based EMS typically adopts a simplified integrated-bus power balance model. While this simplification is effective for small networks, large-scale systems require a more detailed branch flow model to account for the increased impact of grid power losses and security constraints. This work proposes an efficient and reliable MPC-based EMS that incorporates power-loss effects and grid-security constraints. %, while adaptively shaping the battery power profile in response to online renewable inputs, achieving reduced operational costs. It enhances system reliability, reduces operational costs, and shows strong potential for online implementation due to its reduced computational effort. Specifically, a second-order cone program (SOCP) branch flow relaxation is integrated into the constraint set, yielding a convex formulation that guarantees globally optimal solutions with high computational efficiency. Owing to the radial topology of the microgrid, this relaxation is practically tight, ensuring equivalence to the original problem. Building on this foundation, an online demand response (DR) module is designed to further reduce the operation cost through peak shaving. To the best of our knowledge, no prior MPC-EMS framework has simultaneously modeled losses and security constraints while coordinating flexible loads within a unified architecture. The developed framework enables secure operation with effective peak shaving and reduced total cost. The effectiveness of the proposed method is validated on 10-bus, 18-bus, and 33-bus systems.

title: In-the-Flow Agentic System Optimization for Effective Planning and Tool Use
comments: 47 pages, 12 figures. ICLR 2026 Oral. Project website: https://agentflow.stanford.edu/
summary: Outcome-driven reinforcement learning has advanced reasoning in large language models (LLMs), but prevailing tool-augmented approaches train a single, monolithic policy that interleaves thoughts and tool calls under full context; this scales poorly with long horizons and diverse tools and generalizes weakly to new scenarios. Agentic systems offer a promising alternative by decomposing work across specialized modules, yet most remain training-free or rely on offline training decoupled from the live dynamics of multi-turn interaction. We introduce AgentFlow, a trainable, in-the-flow agentic framework that coordinates four modules (planner, executor, verifier, generator) through an evolving memory and directly optimizes its planner inside the multi-turn loop. To train on-policy in live environments, we propose Flow-based Group Refined Policy Optimization (Flow-GRPO), which tackles long-horizon, sparse-reward credit assignment by converting multi-turn optimization into a sequence of tractable single-turn policy updates. It broadcasts a single, verifiable trajectory-level outcome to every turn to align local planner decisions with global success and stabilizes learning with group-normalized advantages. Across ten benchmarks, AgentFlow with a 7B-scale backbone outperforms top-performing baselines with average accuracy gains of 14.9% on search, 14.0% on agentic, 14.5% on mathematical, and 4.1% on scientific tasks, even surpassing larger proprietary models like GPT-4o. Further analyses confirm the benefits of in-the-flow optimization, showing improved planning, enhanced tool-calling reliability, and positive scaling with model size and reasoning turns.

title: Failure Modes of Always-On Inter-Cluster Repulsion in Replay-Based Continual Learning
comments: v3: Substantially revised as a negative-results study. All reported values recomputed from verified experimental runs; method description corrected to match the released implementation; statistical aggregation corrected to per-seed population standard deviations. 4 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Code: https://github.com/AminHasibul/Continual-Learning-UsingInterClusterDistance
summary: Feature-space objectives are often added to replay-based continual learning systems with the expectation that better geometric separation will improve retention. We study a preliminary form of Cluster-Aware Replay (CAR) that combines a class-balanced replay memory with an always-active inter-cluster repulsion term (ICF). On five-task Split CIFAR-10 with a ResNet-18 backbone, the highest observed mean in a six-value sensitivity sweep reaches $22.5\pm1.4\%$ final average accuracy over three seeds, compared with $23.1\pm2.5\%$ for replay alone. ICF without replay reaches only $19.2\pm0.1\%$. All tested repulsion weights produce final accuracies between $20.1\%$ and $22.5\%$, and the detailed configuration exhibits $89.2\pm1.5$ percentage points of average forgetting. An instrumented rerun shows that the weighted repulsion contribution remains near $-0.13$ after cross-entropy has fallen close to zero, so the total objective becomes negative while old-task accuracy collapses. Importantly, the normalized distance objective is mathematically bounded; the failure is therefore better described as non-saturating, always-on repulsion rather than an unbounded loss. These negative results show that geometric separation is not automatically complementary to replay and motivate margin-gated objectives whose gradients deactivate once sufficient separation has been reached.
