title: 4DGS360: 360° Gaussian Reconstruction of Dynamic Objects from a Single Video
comments: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://jaewon040.github.io/4dgs360/
summary: We introduce 4DGS360, a diffusion-free framework for 360$^{\circ}$ dynamic object reconstruction from casual monocular video. Existing methods often fail to reconstruct consistent 360$^{\circ}$ geometry, as their heavy reliance on 2D-native priors causes initial points to overfit to visible surface in each training view. 4DGS360 addresses this challenge through a advanced 3D-native initialization that mitigates the geometric ambiguity of occluded regions. Our proposed 3D tracker, AnchorTAP3D, produces reinforced 3D point trajectories by leveraging confident 2D track points as anchors, suppressing drift and providing reliable initialization that preserves geometry in occluded regions. This initialization, combined with optimization, yields coherent 360$^{\circ}$ 4D reconstructions. We further present iPhone360, a new benchmark where test cameras are placed up to 135$^{\circ}$ apart from training views, enabling 360$^{\circ}$ evaluation that existing datasets cannot provide. Experiments show that 4DGS360 achieves state-of-the-art performance on the iPhone360, iPhone, and DAVIS datasets, both qualitatively and quantitatively.
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://jaewon040.github.io/4dgs360/

title: Directional Mollification for Knot-Preserving $C^{\infty}$ Smoothing of Polygonal Chains with Explicit Curvature Bounds
summary: We introduce the \textit{directional mollification} operator, which acts on polygonal chains to produce $C^{\infty}$ curve approximants that are arbitrarily close to the original curve -- pointwise and uniformly on compact subsets -- while strictly interpolating its vertices. Unlike standard mollification, which fails to preserve vertices, this directional construction enables local, vertex-preserving smoothing; modifying a single segment alters the $C^{\infty}$ output only within an explicitly controllable neighborhood. The operator admits closed-form curvature bounds and provides analytic control over curve geometry. Furthermore, we develop a parametric family of smoothing operators that unifies conventional and directional mollification into a single framework. Combining computational simplicity with strict waypoint fidelity, this method is directly applicable to geometric modeling, robotics, computer graphics, and CNC machining.

title: Effort-Based Criticality Metrics for Evaluating 3D Perception Errors in Autonomous Driving
comments: Accepted at IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026
summary: Criticality metrics such as time-to-collision (TTC) quantify collision urgency but do not distinguish the operational consequences of false-positive (FP) and false-negative (FN) perception errors. We formulate two error-specific effort metrics: False Speed Reduction (FSR), the cumulative velocity loss associated with persistent phantom detections, and Maximum Deceleration Rate (MDR), the peak braking demand associated with missed objects under a longitudinal kinematic model. These longitudinal metrics are complemented by Lateral Evasion Acceleration (LEA), adapted from prior lateral-evasion kinematics and coupled with reachability-based collision timing. The collision check quantifies the minimum steering effort required to avoid a predicted collision. A dynamically conservative, semantically unfiltered reachability gate selects candidate interactions before frame-level scoring and track-level aggregation. Evaluation on nuScenes and Argoverse 2 shows that 65% to 93% of errors fall below the chosen criticality thresholds. Correlation and threshold analysis indicate that the proposed metrics provide complementary rankings for screening and mining perception failures and are not substitutes for closed-loop safety validation.
comment: Accepted at IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026

title: Pre-Deployment Complexity Estimation for Federated Perception Systems
comments: Accepted and presented at Edge AI Research Symposium 2026 (EdgeAI2026), San Diego, CA
summary: Edge AI systems increasingly rely on federated learning to train perception models in distributed, privacy-preserving, and resource-constrained environments. Before training, however, practitioners often lack practical tools for estimating task difficulty in terms of expected accuracy and communication effort. We present a classifier-agnostic, pre-deployment framework that combines intrinsic data properties such as dimensionality, sparsity, and heterogeneity, with client-distribution composition to estimate learning complexity in federated perception systems. Using federated learning as a representative distributed training setting, we examine how learning difficulty varies across different federated configurations. Experiments on three MNIST variants show strong negative correlations between the combined complexity metric and maximum and average federated accuracy, while the intrinsic and distributed components exhibit consistent relationships with communication effort. These findings suggest that complexity estimation can serve as a practical diagnostic tool for resource planning, dataset assessment, and feasibility evaluation in edge-deployed perception systems.
comment: Accepted and presented at Edge AI Research Symposium 2026 (EdgeAI2026), San Diego, CA

title: Legible Consensus: Topology-Aware Quorum Geometry for Asymmetric Networks
summary: Quorum design over asymmetric topologies conflates two independent concerns: inter-tier obligation (which tiers must participate for cross-tier safety) and intra-tier replication (how each tier survives local failures). Flat quorums treat all nodes as interchangeable; when consensus fails, the structure does not reveal whether a tier was unreachable or a tier lost too many replicas. We show that mapping a crumbling-wall quorum construction to a physically tiered network separates these concerns and makes the protocol's failure modes legible: an operator can determine which tiers retain global consensus capability from the wall structure and connectivity state alone, without runtime probing. Using a 10-node Earth/LEO/Moon/Mars topology as a magnifying glass, we confirm that three of four tiers retain global liveness during Mars conjunction blackout; only the disconnected tier loses it. Consensus latency at each tier equals the speed-of-light round-trip to Earth: 183~ms (Earth), 131~ms (LEO), 5.1~s (Moon). The wall also imposes a leadership cost gradient on Multi-Paxos elections that symmetric grid quorums cannot express. A comparison between sparse and full-coverage topologies separates wall obligations from network reachability as independent liveness constraints. All results are design-level; quorum intersection is verified exhaustively in TLA+.

title: Crashing Waves vs. Rising Tides: Findings on AI Automation from Thousands of Worker Evaluations of Labor Market Tasks
summary: We propose that AI automation is a continuum between: (i) crashing waves where AI capabilities surge abruptly over small sets of tasks, and (ii) rising tides where the increase in AI capabilities is more continuous and broad-based. We test for these effects in preliminary evidence from an ongoing evaluation of AI capabilities across over 3,000 broad-based tasks derived from the U.S. Department of Labor O*NET categorization that are text-based and thus LLM-addressable. Based on more than 17,000 evaluations by workers from these jobs, we find little evidence of crashing waves (in contrast to recent work by METR), but substantial evidence that rising tides are the primary form of AI automation. AI performance is high and improving rapidly across a wide range of tasks. We estimate that, in 2024-Q2, AI models successfully complete tasks that take humans approximately 3-4 hours with about a 50% success rate, increasing to about 65% by 2025-Q3. If recent trends in AI capability growth persist, this pace of AI improvement implies that LLMs will be able to complete most text-related tasks with success rates of, on average, 80%-95% by 2029 at a minimally sufficient quality level. Achieving near-perfect success rates at this quality level or comparable success rates at superior quality would require several additional years. These AI capability improvements would impact the economy and labor market as organizations adopt AI, which could have a substantially longer timeline.

title: DocShield: Towards AI Document Safety via Evidence-Grounded Agentic Reasoning
comments: 10 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Preprint. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2512.21482
summary: The rapid progress of generative AI has enabled increasingly realistic text-centric image forgeries, posing major challenges to document safety. Existing forensic methods mainly rely on visual cues and lack evidence-based reasoning to reveal subtle text manipulations. Detection, localization, and explanation are often treated as isolated tasks, limiting reliability and interpretability. To tackle these challenges, we propose DocShield, the first unified framework formulating text-centric forgery analysis as a visual-logical co-reasoning problem. At its core, a novel Cross-Cues-aware Chain of Thought (CCT) mechanism enables implicit agentic reasoning, iteratively cross-validating visual anomalies with textual semantics to produce consistent, evidence-grounded forensic analysis. We further introduce a Weighted Multi-Task Reward for GRPO-based optimization, aligning reasoning structure, spatial evidence, and authenticity prediction. Complementing the framework, we construct RealText-V1, a multilingual dataset of document-like text images with pixel-level manipulation masks and expert-level textual explanations. Extensive experiments show DocShield significantly outperforms existing methods, improving macro-average F1 by 41.4% over specialized frameworks and 23.4% over GPT-4o on T-IC13, with consistent gains on the challenging T-SROIE benchmark. Our dataset, model, and code will be publicly released.
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Preprint. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2512.21482

title: Measuring LLM Trust Allocation Across Conflicting Software Artifacts
summary:
LLM-based software engineering assistants often reason over multiple artifacts, including code, documentation, signatures, and tests, even when those artifacts are incomplete or mutually inconsistent. Existing evaluations primarily measure final outputs, leaving unclear whether a model recognized unreliable evidence, identified the faulty source, or prioritized the appropriate artifact.
  We introduce TRACE, a controlled method for evaluating how LLMs assess and prioritize conflicting software artifacts. TRACE constructs paired clean and perturbed versions of real-world Java method bundles by injecting known faults into the documentation, implementation, or both while holding the remaining artifacts fixed. Models then assess artifact quality, detect and localize inconsistencies, and rank the available sources by reliability. Using 22,339 valid responses from seven LLMs on 456 method bundles, we find that quality penalties are generally localized to the perturbed artifact and increase with fault severity. However, models exhibit a consistent source-origin asymmetry: they detect documentation faults at 67-94% and explicit documentation-implementation contradictions at 50-91%, but detection falls by 21-43 percentage points when only the implementation changes while documentation remains intact. Models also struggle to deprioritize faulty implementations, and confidence provides little separation between correct and incorrect judgments for six of seven models. These results show that current LLMs are not symmetric integrators of software evidence: they audit natural-language specifications more reliably than subtle implementation behavior. TRACE provides a controlled method for exposing this failure mode before LLMs are used in correctness-critical software engineering workflows.

title: Vocabulary Dropout for Curriculum Diversity in LLM Co-Evolution
summary: Co-evolutionary self-play, where one language model generates problems and another solves them, promises curriculum learning without human supervision. The promise breaks down early in practice. The proposer converges to a narrow distribution of problems that satisfy the reward function, and the collapsed curriculum teaches the solver little, stalling the loop. We introduce vocabulary dropout, a lightweight intervention that randomly masks the proposer's output logits during both policy training and curriculum generation. The mask is hard and non-stationary, so the proposer cannot lock into fixed token sequences. Training Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B on mathematical reasoning via R-Zero, vocabulary dropout sustains proposer diversity throughout training across lexical, semantic, and functional measures, and improves the solver by an average of +4.4 points at 8B with the largest gains on competition-level benchmarks. Explicit action-space constraints, filling the structural role that game rules fill in classical self-play, can keep co-evolution in language productive. Vocabulary dropout is one simple way to impose them.

title: Self-Preference Bias in Rubric-Based Evaluation of Large Language Models
summary: LLM-as-a-judge has become the de facto approach for evaluating LLM outputs. However, judges are known to exhibit self-preference bias (SPB): they tend to favor outputs produced by themselves or by models from their own family. This skews evaluations and, thus, hinders model development, especially in settings of recursive self-improvement. We present the first study of SPB in rubric-based evaluation, an increasingly popular benchmarking paradigm where judges issue binary verdicts on individual evaluation criteria, instead of assigning holistic scores or rankings. Using IFEval and LiveCodeBench, benchmarks with programmatically verifiable rubrics, we show that SPB persists even when evaluation criteria are entirely objective: among rubrics where generators fail, judges can be more than 50% more likely to incorrectly mark them as satisfied when the output is their own. We also find that, similarly to other evaluation paradigms, ensembling multiple judges helps mitigate SPB, but without fully eliminating it. On HealthBench, a medical chat benchmark with subjective rubrics, we observe that SPB skews model scores by up to 10 points, a potentially decisive margin when ranking frontier models. We analyze the factors that drive SPB in this setting, finding that negative rubrics and subjective topics like communication and emergency referrals are particularly susceptible.

title: A Unified Survival Benchmark for Temporal Dropout Risk Prediction in Learning Analytics
comments: 64 pages, 11 figures, 20 tables, 63 references. Survival analysis benchmark for student dropout prediction using OULAD dataset
summary: Student dropout is a persistent concern in Learning Analytics, yet comparative studies frequently evaluate predictive models under heterogeneous protocols, prioritizing discrimination over temporal interpretability and calibration. This study introduces a survival-oriented benchmark for temporal dropout risk modelling using the Open University Learning Analytics Dataset (OULAD). Two arms are compared: Family A: Dynamic Weekly, with models in person-period representation, and Family B: Static Early-Window, with an expanded roster of families: tree-based survival, parametric, and neural models. The evaluation protocol integrates four analytical layers: predictive performance, ablation, explainability, and calibration. Results are reported within each family separately, because a single numerical cross-family ranking would conflate genuine model differences with artifacts of temporal representation, to which survival metrics are known to be sensitive. Within Family B, Random Survival Forest showed the highest point estimates for time-dependent concordance and the lowest Brier scores across all three horizons; within Family A, Poisson Piecewise-Exponential showed the lowest point estimate for integrated Brier score within a tight five-model cluster. No-refit bootstrap resampling qualifies these positions as directional signals, not claims of strict superiority. Ablation and explainability analyses converged, across all models, on a shared finding: the dominant predictive signal was not primarily demographic or structural, but temporal and behavioral. Calibration corroborated this pattern in the better-discriminating models, except for XGBoost AFT, the sole outlier (analyzed in the Discussion). These results support unified, multi-dimensional benchmarking in Learning Analytics and situate dropout risk as a temporal-behavioral process rather than a function of static background attributes.
comment: 64 pages, 11 figures, 20 tables, 63 references. Survival analysis benchmark for student dropout prediction using OULAD dataset

title: An Auditable Policy-Simulation Framework for Student Dropout in Intervention-Free Data
comments: Approx. 20 pages, 9 figures. Code and reproducibility package available at https://github.com/rafa-rodriguess/TCM-Student-Dropout This work introduces a temporal survival framework with counterfactual policy simulation
summary: This study proposes a temporal modeling framework with a counterfactual policy-simulation layer for student dropout in higher education, using LMS engagement data and administrative withdrawal records. Dropout is operationalized as a time-to-event outcome at the enrollment level; weekly risk is modeled in discrete time via penalized, class-balanced logistic regression over person--period rows. Under a late-event temporal holdout, the model attains row-level AUCs of 0.8350 (train) and 0.8405 (test), with aggregate calibration acceptable but sparsely supported in the highest-risk bins. Ablation analyses indicate performance is sensitive to feature set composition, underscoring the role of temporal engagement signals. A scenario-indexed policy layer produces survival contrasts $ΔS(T)$ under an explicit trigger/schedule contract: positive contrasts are confined to the shock branch ($T_{\rm policy}=18$: 0.0102, 0.0260, 0.0819), while the mechanism-aware branch is negative ($ΔS_{\rm mech}(18)=-0.0078$, $ΔS_{\rm mech}(38)=-0.0134$). A subgroup analysis by gender quantifies scenario-induced survival gaps via bootstrap; contrasts are directionally stable but small. Results are not causally identified; they demonstrate the framework's capacity for internal structural scenario comparison under observational data constraints.
comment: Approx. 20 pages, 9 figures. Code and reproducibility package available at https://github.com/rafa-rodriguess/TCM-Student-Dropout This work introduces a temporal survival framework with counterfactual policy simulation

AI.title_translation: 无干预数据下学生退学的可审计策略模拟框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个结合离散时间风险预测与反事实策略模拟的框架，用于利用无干预的教育数据评估学生退学风险与策略干预效果。
AI.motivation: 高等教育中的学生退学预防通常缺乏干预性实验数据，因此需要一种能够在仅有观察性（无干预）数据的约束下，进行结构化情景比较和策略模拟的可审计框架。
AI.method: 使用学习管理系统（LMS）参与数据和行政退学记录，将退学建模为注册级别的离散时间-事件（time-to-event）结果；基于个人-时间段（person-period）数据，利用带惩罚且类别平衡的逻辑回归模型预测每周退学风险；构建情景索引策略层以评估反事实生存对比 $\Delta S(T)$，并通过自助法（bootstrap）进行性别亚组分析。
AI.result: 在晚期事件时间保留测试集上，模型在行级别上取得了0.8405的AUC（训练集0.8350）；冲击分支表现出正向生存对比（最高0.0819），而机制感知分支表现出负向对比；按性别的亚组分析表明情景诱导的生存差距方向稳定但幅度较小。
AI.conclusion: 尽管结果未达到因果识别的标准，但研究证明了该框架在观察性数据约束下具备进行内部结构化情景比较与反事实策略评估的能力。
AI.translation: 本研究提出了一种带有反事实策略模拟层的时间建模框架，利用高等教育中的学习管理系统（LMS）参与数据和行政退学记录来预测学生退学。退学被具体化为注册层面的时间-事件结果；通过对“个人-时段”行数据应用带惩罚的类别平衡离散时间逻辑回归来对每周风险进行建模。在晚期事件时间保留验证下，该模型在行级别上取得了0.8350（训练集）和0.8405（测试集）的AUC，总体校准良好，但在极高风险区间的数据支撑较为稀疏。消融分析表明模型性能对特征集组成敏感，突显了时间参与信号的作用。情景索引策略层在明确的触发/调度契约下生成生存对比 $\Delta S(T)$：正向对比仅限于冲击分支（$T_{\rm policy}=18$：0.0102, 0.0260, 0.0819），而机制感知分支则为负（$\Delta S_{\rm mech}(18)=-0.0078$, $\Delta S_{\rm mech}(38)=-0.0134$）。按性别进行的亚组分析通过自助法量化了情景诱导的生存差距；对比在方向上稳定但数值较小。结果虽然缺乏因果识别，但展示了该框架在观察性数据约束下进行内部结构化情景比较的能力。
AI.summary: 本文针对高等教育学生退学预测与干预评估，提出了一种包含时间建模与反事实策略模拟层的可审计框架。该框架利用LMS行为数据和行政记录，通过离散时间逻辑回归预测每周退学风险，取得了良好的判别性能（测试集AUC 0.8405）。同时，框架引入了策略模拟层，可在无需真实干预数据的约束下进行反事实干预情景对比与亚组差异分析。
AI.keywords: 学生退学, 策略模拟, 离散时间逻辑回归, 学习分析, 反事实分析
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将时间-事件风险建模（离散时间逻辑回归）与反事实策略模拟层结合，允许在缺乏真实干预实验的观察性数据下评估不同政策/干预时机的影响。局限性在于作者明确指出结果未进行因果识别（not causally identified），且模型在极高风险分桶的校准数据较为稀疏，应用于实际干预决策时需谨慎。

title: Internal Knowledge Without External Expression: Probing the Generalization Boundary of a Classical Chinese Language Model
summary:
We train a 318M-parameter Transformer language model from scratch on a curated corpus of 1.56 billion tokens of pure Classical Chinese, with zero English characters or Arabic numerals. Through systematic out-of-distribution (OOD) testing, we investigate whether the model can distinguish known from unknown inputs, and crucially, whether it can express this distinction in its generated text.
  We find a clear dissociation between internal and external uncertainty. Internally, the model exhibits a perplexity jump ratio of 2.39x between real and fabricated historical events (p = 8.9e-11, n = 92 per group), with semi-fabricated events (real figures + fictional events) showing the highest perplexity (4.24x, p = 1.1e-16), demonstrating genuine factual encoding beyond syntactic pattern matching. Externally, however, the model never learns to express uncertainty: classical Chinese epistemic markers appear at lower rates for OOD questions (3.5%) than for in-distribution questions (8.3%, p = 0.023), reflecting rhetorical conventions in the training data rather than genuine metacognition.
  We replicate both findings across three languages (Classical Chinese, English, Japanese), three writing systems, and eight models from 110M to 1.56B parameters. We further show that uncertainty expression frequency is determined entirely by training data conventions, not epistemic states, with Classical Chinese models showing a "humility paradox" (more hedging for known topics), while Japanese models almost never hedge. We argue that metacognitive expression -- the ability to say "I don't know" -- does not emerge from language modeling alone and requires explicit training signals such as RLHF.

AI.title_translation: 内部知识与外部表达脱节：探究古代汉语语言模型的泛化边界
AI.tldr: 模型内部能通过困惑度区分虚构与已知事实，但外部文本无法表达“不确定性”，表明元认知能力无法仅靠语言建模涌现。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型是否能够在内部区分已知与未知输入，以及模型是否能够在生成的文本中正确表达这种内部的不确定性（即元认知表达）。
AI.method: 从零开始在15.6亿Token纯古代汉语语料上训练3.18亿参数的Transformer模型，并进行分布外（OOD）测试；随后在3种语言（古汉语、英语、日语）、3种书写系统及8个模型（1.1亿~15.6亿参数）上进行复现与对比分析。
AI.result:
1. 内部不确定性：模型在真实与虚构历史事件间表现出2.39倍的困惑度跳跃（半虚构事件达4.24倍），证明其具备超越语法匹配的事实编码能力；
2. 外部表达脱节：分布外问题中认识论标记的出现率（3.5%）低于分布内问题（8.3%），无法准确表达不确定性；
3. 跨语言复现显示表达频率完全由训练数据习惯决定（如古汉语模型的“谦逊悖论”与日语模型的极少对冲）。
AI.conclusion: 元认知表达能力（如表达“我不知道”）无法仅通过预训练语言建模自然涌现，而是需要显式的训练信号（如RLHF）。
AI.translation:
我们从零开始，在一个由15.6亿Token纯古代汉语（零英文或阿拉伯数字）构成的精选语料库上训练了一个3.18亿参数的Transformer语言模型。通过系统性的分布外（OOD）测试，我们研究了模型是否能够区分已知与未知的输入，更重要的是，它是否能在其生成的文本中表达这种区分。
我们发现模型的内部不确定性与外部表达之间存在明显的脱节。在内部，模型在真实历史事件与虚构历史事件之间的困惑度跳跃比为2.39倍（p = 8.9e-11，每组n = 92），其中半虚构事件（真实人物+虚构事件）显示出最高的困惑度（4.24倍，p = 1.1e-16），这证明了超越语法模式匹配的真实事实编码。然而在外部，模型从未学会表达不确定性：分布外问题中古代汉语认识论标记的出现率（3.5%）反而低于分布内问题（8.3%，p = 0.023），这反映的是训练数据中的修辞习惯，而非真正的元认知。
我们在三种语言（古代汉语、英语、日语）、三种书写系统以及从1.1亿到15.6亿参数的八个模型中复现了这两项发现。我们进一步表明，不确定性表达的频率完全由训练数据习惯决定，而非由认识状态决定：古代汉语模型表现出“谦逊悖论”（对已知主题有更多对冲表达），而日语模型则几乎从不对冲。我们认为，元认知表达能力——即说出“我不知道”的能力——无法仅通过语言建模涌现，而是需要诸如RLHF等显式训练信号。
AI.summary: 本研究通过在纯古代汉语及多语言语料上训练不同规模的语言模型，探究了模型内部知识与外部表达的关系。结果表明，语言模型内部可以通过困惑度准确区分真实与虚构事实，但其生成的外部文本却受训练集修辞习惯支配，无法表达内部不确定性，证明元认知表达能力无法单靠语言建模涌现。
AI.keywords: 古代汉语语言模型, 不确定性脱节, 元认知表达, 分布外泛化, 谦逊悖论
AI.comments: 本研究的创新之处在于利用纯古代汉语等无干扰文本环境，系统揭示了模型内部知识隐征与外部生成表达之间的“失配”现象，并提出了“谦逊悖论”等有趣现象。论文切中大模型幻觉与元认知研究的痛点，有力证明了仅靠自监督预训练无法使模型产生真实的“自我知晓”表达，为RLHF等后训练对齐技术的必要性提供了坚实的经验依据。

title: Material-agnostic temperature field prediction for metal additive manufacturing via a parametric PINN framework
summary: Accurate temperature field prediction in metal additive manufacturing (AM) is essential for understanding the process-structure-performance relationship. While prior studies have explored generalization to unseen process conditions, they often require extensive datasets, costly retraining, or pre-training. Generalization across different materials also remains relatively unexplored due to the challenges posed by distinct material-dependent thermal behaviors. This paper introduces a parametric physics-informed neural network (PINN) framework for generalization across unseen materials without labeled data, retraining, or pre-training. The framework adopts a decoupled parametric PINN architecture that separately encodes material properties and spatiotemporal coordinates, fusing them through conditional modulation to better align with the multiplicative role of material parameters in the governing equation and boundary conditions. Physics-guided output scaling derived from Rosenthal's analytical solution and a hybrid optimization strategy are further incorporated to enhance physical consistency, training stability, and convergence. Experiments with numerical simulations across diverse metal alloys, including both in-distribution and out-of-distribution cases, demonstrate effective generalizability along with superior training efficiency. Specifically, the proposed framework achieved up to a 64.2% reduction in relative L2 error compared to the non-parametric baseline while surpassing its performance within only 4.4% of the baseline training epochs. Ablation studies clarify each component's contribution and scrutinize the severe training instability prevalent in conventional parametric PINNs. Overall, the proposed framework provides an efficient and scalable material-agnostic solution for temperature field modeling, contributing to more flexible and practical deployment in metal AM.

AI.title_translation: 基于参数化PINN框架的金属增材制造跨材料温度场预测
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需重新训练和标注数据的参数化PINN框架，实现了金属增材制造中跨未见材料的高效稳定温度场预测。
AI.motivation: 金属增材制造中的温度场预测对理解工艺-结构-性能关系至关重要，但现有跨条件泛化方法依赖庞大数据集、高昂的重新训练或预训练成本，且由于不同材料的热学行为差异显著，跨材料的无监督泛化研究仍存在较大空白。
AI.method: 提出了一种解耦的参数化PINN架构，将材料属性和时空坐标分别编码并通过条件调制融合；融合了基于Rosenthal解析解的物理引导输出缩放；采用混合优化策略以增强物理一致性、训练稳定性与收敛速度。
AI.result: 在多种金属合金（含分布内和分布外样本）的数值模拟测试中，所提框架相比非参数基线将相对L2误差降低了高达64.2%，且仅用基线4.4%的训练轮数即实现了性能超越。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为金属增材制造中的温度场预测提供了一种高效、可扩展且与材料无关的解决方案，有助于推动增材制造技术在实际工业场景中更灵活和实用的部署。
AI.translation: 金属增材制造（AM）中准确的温度场预测对于理解“工艺-组织-性能”关系至关重要。尽管先前的研究探索了对未见工艺条件的泛化，但它们通常需要庞大的数据集、高昂的重新训练或预训练成本。由于不同材料具有独特且相差较大的热学行为，跨不同材料的泛化研究目前仍相对较少。本文介绍了一种参数化物理信息神经网络（PINN）框架，用于在无需标记数据、重新训练或预训练的情况下泛化到未见材料。该框架采用解耦的参数化PINN架构，分别对材料属性和时空坐标进行编码，并通过条件调制将其融合，以更好地契合材料参数在控制方程和边界条件中的乘积作用。此外，还引入了源自Rosenthal解析解的物理引导输出缩放以及混合优化策略，以增强物理一致性、训练稳定性和收敛性。跨多种金属合金（包括分布内和分布外情况）的数值模拟实验表明，该框架具有出色的泛化能力和优异的训练效率。具体而言，与非参数基线相比，所提出的框架将相对L2误差降低了高达64.2%，并且仅需基线训练轮数的4.4%即可超越基线性能。消融实验阐明了各组件的贡献，并深入分析了传统参数化PINN中普遍存在的严重训练不稳定性。总体而言，所提出的框架为温度场建模提供了一种高效且具扩展性的材料无关解决方案，促进了金属增材制造中更灵活和实用的部署。
AI.summary: 针对金属增材制造中跨材料温度场预测难的问题，本文提出了一种基于解耦编码与条件调制的参数化物理信息神经网络（PINN）框架。该方法无需标注数据或重新训练，结合物理引导的输出缩放和混合优化，大幅提升了计算效率、稳定性和泛化精度。
AI.keywords: 增材制造, 温度场预测, 物理信息神经网络, 参数化模型, 跨材料泛化
AI.comments: 本研究的创新点在于将材料热物理属性与时空坐标解耦编码，并利用条件调制融合，巧妙契合了控制方程中材料参数的作用方式。引入Rosenthal解析解进行物理引导缩放，显著改善了传统参数化PINN训练不稳定的痛点，在大幅提升预测精度的同时将训练轮数缩减至原有的4.4%，对金属增材制造中多材料快速工艺设计具有重要的实用价值。

title: Generative Augmented Inference of LLM-generated Data for Market Research: Theory and Empirical Evidence
summary: Marketing research often relies on parameters estimated from costly human-generated data, such as conjoint survey responses, purchase decisions, and field experiment outcomes. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and other AI systems offer inexpensive auxiliary data, but introduce a new challenge: AI outputs are not direct observations of the target outcomes, but could involve high-dimensional representations with complex and unknown relationships to human labels. Conventional methods leverage AI predictions as direct proxies for true labels, which can be inefficient or unreliable when this relationship is weak or misspecified. We propose Generative Augmented Inference (GAI), a general framework that incorporates AI-generated outputs as informative features for estimating models of human-labeled outcomes. GAI uses an orthogonal moment construction that enables consistent estimation and valid inference with a flexible, nonparametric relationship between LLM-generated outputs and human labels. We establish asymptotic normality and a key dominance result: under random labeling, GAI is optimal within a unified class of debiased estimators-including human-data-only estimators and state-of-the-art debiasing methods-and delivers strict improvements under a mild informativeness condition. Even when the labeled sample is not representative of the target population, an extended variant of GAI still dominates the weighted human-data-only estimator. Empirically, GAI outperforms benchmarks across diverse marketing research settings. In a conjoint analysis, it halves estimation error and reduces human labeling requirements by over 75%. In a pricing study, it consistently outperforms alternative estimators when all methods receive identical auxiliary inputs. In a health insurance study, it saves over 90% of labels while preserving decision accuracy.

AI.title_translation: 面向市场研究的大模型生成数据生成增强推理：理论与实证依据
AI.tldr: 提出生成增强推理（GAI）框架，将LLM生成数据作为有效特征融入统计推断，在大幅减少75%-90%人工标注成本的同时提升估算精确度。
AI.motivation: 市场研究依赖昂贵的人工标注数据（如联合调查、购买决策等）。虽然大语言模型（LLM）能提供廉价辅助数据，但AI输出并非目标结果的直接观测值，且与真实标签间关系未知且复杂。直接将AI预测当作真实标签的传统方法在关系较弱或模型误设定时效率低下且不可靠。
AI.method: 提出生成增强推理（GAI）框架，将AI生成的输出作为特征纳入到估计人类标签结果的模型中。GAI采用正交矩构造（orthogonal moment construction），允许LLM生成输出与真实人类标签之间存在灵活且非参数的关系，从而确保一致估计和有效的统计推断。
AI.result: 理论上，证明了GAI估计量的渐近正态性，并在随机标注与非代表性样本下证明了其优于现有去偏方法与仅人类数据估计量；实证上，GAI在联合分析中将估计误差减半并减少75%以上的人工标注需求，在定价研究中持续超越基准方法，在健康保险研究中保留决策准确度的同时节省了90%以上的人工标签。
AI.conclusion: GAI框架能够有效地将大模型生成的廉价辅助数据与高成本的人工标注数据相结合，在保证统计推断一致性与有效性的同时，大幅降低市场研究中的数据采集成本并提升决策精度。
AI.translation: 市场营销研究通常依赖于从昂贵的人工生成数据中估计的参数，例如联合分析调查响应、购买决策和现场实验结果。大语言模型（LLM）和其他AI系统的最新进展提供了廉价的辅助数据，但引入了新的挑战：AI输出并非目标结果的直接观察值，而是可能包含与人类标签存在复杂且未知关系的维度表示。传统方法利用AI预测作为真实标签的直接代理，当这种关系较弱或误设定时，可能会效率低下或不可靠。我们提出了生成增强推理（GAI），这是一个将AI生成的输出作为有信息量的特征纳入估算人类标签结果模型中的通用框架。GAI利用正交矩构造，能够在LLM生成的输出与人类标签之间存在灵活的非参数关系时，实现一致估计和有效推断。我们建立了渐近正态性和一个关键的主导性结果：在随机标注下，GAI 在包括仅人类数据估计量和最先进的去偏方法在内的统一去偏估计量类中是最优的，并在温和的信息量条件下带来严格的改善。即使当标注样本对目标总体不具代表性时，GAI的扩展变体仍然主导加权的仅人类数据估计量。在实证方面，GAI在各种市场营销研究场景中均优于基准方法。在联合分析中，它将估计误差减半，并将人工标注需求减少了75%以上。在定价研究中，当所有方法获得相同的辅助输入时，它的表现持续优于其他估计量。在健康保险研究中，它在保持决策准确性的同时节省了90%以上的人工标签。
AI.summary: 本文提出了生成增强推理（GAI）通用框架，旨在利用LLM生成的廉价辅助数据来增强基于高成本人类标注数据的市场研究模型估计。通过正交矩构造，GAI克服了AI输出与真实标签间复杂的未知关系问题，实现了统计上一致且最优的推断。实证表明，GAI能大幅减少75%至90%以上的人工标注需求，同时显著提高估计与决策准确率。
AI.keywords: 生成增强推理, 大语言模型, 市场研究, 数据效率, 正交矩
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将大语言模型（LLM）生成的辅助数据与半参数估计及正交矩推断技术相结合，解决了以往直接将AI输出作为真实标签代理时易出现的误设定与低效问题。从理论上证明了在保持无偏性的同时实现极高的统计效率，对于大幅降低市场营销调查与实验中的昂贵人工数据采集成本具有重大的应用价值。

title: OC-Distill: Ontology-aware Contrastive Learning with Cross-Modal Distillation for ICU Risk Prediction
summary: Early prediction of severe clinical deterioration and remaining length of stay can enable timely intervention and better resource allocation in high-acuity settings such as the ICU. This has driven the development of machine learning models that leverage continuous streams of vital signs and other physiological signals for real-time risk prediction. Despite their promise, existing methods have important limitations. Contrastive pretraining treats all patients as equally strong negatives, failing to capture clinically meaningful similarity between patients with related diagnoses. Meanwhile, downstream fine-tuning typically ignores complementary modalities such as clinical notes, which provide rich contextual information unavailable in physiological signals alone. To address these challenges, we propose OC-Distill, a two-stage framework that leverages multimodal supervision during training while requiring only vital signs at inference. In the first stage, we introduce an ontology-aware contrastive objective that exploits the ICD hierarchy to quantify patient similarity and learn clinically grounded representations. In the second stage, we fine-tune the pretrained encoder via cross-modal knowledge distillation, transferring complementary information from clinical notes into the model. Across multiple ICU prediction tasks on MIMIC, OC-Distill demonstrates improved label efficiency and achieves state-of-the-art performance among methods that use only vital signs at inference.

AI.title_translation: OC-Distill：结合跨模态蒸馏与本体感知对比学习的ICU风险预测方法
AI.tldr: OC-Distill通过整合ICD本体对比学习与临床记录跨模态蒸馏，实现了在推理阶段仅用生命体征信号即可达到SOTA水平的ICU风险预测。
AI.motivation: 现有的ICU风险预测方法存在两大局限：对比预训练将所有其他患者均视为等同的强负样本，无法捕捉相关诊断患者间的临床相似性；下游微调通常忽略了临床记录等互补模态所提供的丰富上下文信息。
AI.method: 提出了两阶段框架OC-Distill（训练阶段利用多模态，推理阶段仅需体征数据）：1. 第一阶段引入本体感知对比学习目标，利用ICD分层结构量化患者间临床相似度；2. 第二阶段通过跨模态知识蒸馏进行微调，将临床记录中的互补上下文信息迁移至体征编码器中。
AI.result: 在基于MIMIC数据集的多个ICU预测任务中，OC-Distill展示出了更高的标签利用效率，并在推理阶段仅使用体征信号的方法中取得了最先进（SOTA）的性能。
AI.conclusion: OC-Distill通过将医疗本体知识与跨模态蒸馏引入预训练及微调阶段，成功实现了低推理门槛下的高性能重症风险预测，为临床实时监控与资源调配提供了有力支持。
AI.translation: 早期预测严重临床恶化和剩余住院时间可以在ICU等高风险环境中实现及时干预和更好的资源分配。这促使了利用生命体征和其他生理信号的连续流进行实时风险预测的机器学习模型的发展。尽管这些方法前景广阔，但仍存在重要局限性。对比预训练将所有患者视为等同的强负样本，未能捕捉具有相关诊断的患者之间具有临床意义的相似性。同时，下游微调通常忽略了诸如临床记录等互补模态，这些模态提供了仅凭生理信号无法获得的丰富上下文信息。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了OC-Distill，这是一个在训练期间利用多模态监督但在推理时仅需要生命体征的两阶段框架。在第一阶段，我们引入了一个本体感知对比目标，利用ICD分层结构来量化患者相似性并学习具有临床依据的表征。在第二阶段，我们通过跨模态知识蒸馏微调预训练编码器，将临床记录中的互补信息转移到模型中。在MIMIC上的多个ICU预测任务中，OC-Distill展示了提高的标签效率，并在推理时仅使用生命体征的方法中取得了最先进的性能。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有ICU风险预测模型无法有效捕捉临床相似度及忽视多模态信息的问题，提出了OC-Distill两阶段框架。该框架在预训练阶段利用ICD本体层次结构进行本体感知对比学习，在微调阶段通过跨模态知识蒸馏将临床记录信息融入体征模型中。实验证明，该方法显著提升了推理阶段仅依赖体征信号时的预测性能与标签效率。
AI.keywords: ICU风险预测, 对比学习, 知识蒸馏, 本体感知, 多模态融合
AI.comments: 该论文创新地结合了ICD诊断本体的分层语义与临床文本的跨模态蒸馏，解决了传统对比学习忽略临床相似度以及推理期缺乏多模态数据的问题。其最大的实用价值在于“训练时多模态指导，推理时仅需生理体征信号”，极大降低了部署门槛。局限性在于训练阶段对高质量ICD编码和临床记录的依赖较强，在数据缺失严重的环境下可能受限。

title: DifFoundMAD: Foundation Models meet Differential Morphing Attack Detection
summary: In this work, we introduce DifFoundMAD, a parameter-efficient D-MAD framework that exploits the generalisation capabilities of vision foundation models (FM) to capture discrepancies between suspected morphs and live capture images. In contrast to conventional D-MAD systems that rely on face recognition embeddings or handcrafted feature differences, DifFoundMAD follows the standard differential paradigm while replacing the underlying representation space with embeddings extracted from FMs. By combining lightweight finetuning with class-balanced optimisation, the proposed method updates only a small subset of parameters while preserving the rich representational priors of the underlying FMs. Extensive cross-database evaluations on standard D-MAD benchmarks demonstrate that DifFoundMAD achieves consistent improvements over state-of-the-art systems, particularly at the strict security levels required in operational deployments such as border control: The error rates reported in the current state-of-the-art were reduced from 6.16% to 2.17% for high-security levels using DifFoundMAD

AI.title_translation: DifFoundMAD：视觉基础模型助力微分人脸变形攻击检测
AI.tldr: DifFoundMAD将视觉基础模型与轻量级微调引入微分变形攻击检测，将高安全部署场景下的错误率从6.16%大幅降低至2.17%。
AI.motivation: 传统的微分变形攻击检测（D-MAD）系统通常依赖人脸识别特征嵌入或手工设计的特征差异，在面对未知攻击和跨数据库场景时泛化能力不足。
AI.method: 提出DifFoundMAD框架，使用视觉基础模型提取的特征嵌入替换传统人脸识别或手工特征空间；结合轻量级参数微调与类平衡优化策略，仅更新极少比例的参数，在保留基础模型丰富先验知识的同时实现高效拟合。
AI.result: 在标准D-MAD基准上的广泛跨数据库评估表明，DifFoundMAD显著优于现有的SOTA系统。在边境控制等高安全级别部署要求下，错误率从现有SOTA的6.16%大幅降低至2.17%。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉基础模型应用于微分变形攻击检测能够显著提升检测性能与泛化能力。通过轻量级微调与类平衡优化，该方法在保持高效性的同时，显著增强了高安全性场景下的生物识别防御能力。
AI.translation: 在本研究中，我们提出了DifFoundMAD，这是一个参数高效的微分人脸变形攻击检测（D-MAD）框架，它利用视觉基础模型（FM）的泛化能力来捕获疑似变形图像与现场采集图像之间的差异。与依赖人脸识别嵌入或手工特征差异的传统D-MAD系统不同，DifFoundMAD遵循标准微分范式，同时将底层表示空间替换为从基础模型中提取的嵌入。通过将轻量级微调与类平衡优化相结合，所提出的方法仅更新一小部分参数，同时保留了底层基础模型丰富的表示先验。在标准D-MAD基准上的广泛跨数据库评估表明，DifFoundMAD较现有最先进系统取得了持续的提升，特别是在边境控制等实际部署所需的严格安全级别下：使用DifFoundMAD后，高安全级别下的报告错误率从现有最先进水平的6.16%降低到了2.17%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DifFoundMAD，一种将视觉基础模型应用于微分人脸变形攻击检测（D-MAD）的参数高效框架。该方法通过基础模型特征替代传统人脸识别特征，并结合轻量微调与类平衡优化，在跨数据库评估中表现优异，将严格安全级别的错误率从6.16%降至2.17%。
AI.keywords: Morphing Attack Detection, Foundation Models, Differential MAD, Parameter-Efficient Finetuning, Biometric Security
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将视觉基础模型（Vision Foundation Models）引入微分人脸变形攻击检测（D-MAD）领域，打破了传统方法过度依赖人脸识别特征或手工特征的局限。通过结合轻量级参数高效微调与类平衡优化，模型在保留大模型强泛化先验的同时实现了优异的跨库检测性能，特别是将高安全级别下的错误率大幅降低，对边境管控等实际应用具有极高的参考与落地价值。

title: Monolithically Integrated VO$_2$ Mott Oscillators for Energy-Efficient Spiking Neurons
comments: 24 pages, 7 figures in main text, 8 figures in Supplementary Information
summary: Brain-inspired non-Boolean computing and sensing enable energy-efficient, error-tolerant, and highly parallel information processing, yet their deployment remains limited by the lack of compact, scalable spiking hardware. Mott phase-transition materials offer a promising route because their abrupt insulator-to-metal transitions enable neuron-like thresholding and oscillations. Among them, vanadium dioxide (VO$_2$) is particularly attractive owing to its near-room-temperature transition, fast switching, and scalability. However, existing VO$_2$ neuristors rely on discrete components, limiting integration density. Here, we report monolithic back-end-of-the-line (BEOL) integration of one-transistor-one-VO$_2$-memristor (1T-1MR) spiking neurons on a CMOS-compatible platform. VO$_2$ nanosheets are fabricated by pulsed-laser deposition atop dielectrically isolated silicon-on-insulator (SOI) p-type junctionless field-effect transistors (JLFETs) below 430 $^\circ$C. The architecture exhibits gate-tunable oscillations from 40 to 410 kHz in 60 nm-thin VO$_2$ devices with a 6 $μ$m$^2$ active area, achieving 18 pJ per spike and 8 $μ$W at room temperature, with potential for sub-3 $μ$W operation. We uncover a non-monotonic dependence of oscillation frequency on bias current and temperature and analyze bias-dependent stochastic firing, revealing the nonlinear physics of integrated VO$_2$ thin-film memristors. Finally, we demonstrate voltage-controlled oscillator functionality and on-chip resistive coupling between two nano-oscillators mediated by a JLFET. These results establish a pathway toward dense, energy-efficient, monolithically integrated Mott neuromorphic hardware compatible with future computing and spiking sensing systems.
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures in main text, 8 figures in Supplementary Information

AI.title_translation: 用于高能效脉冲神经元的单片集成VO2 Mott振荡器
AI.tldr: 该研究实现了CMOS兼容的后段制程单片集成VO2-JLFET脉冲神经元，具备超低功耗和可调振荡特性，为高密度类脑计算提供了突破性方案。
AI.motivation: 类脑非布尔计算与感知需要紧凑且可扩展的脉冲硬件，而现有的二氧化钒（VO2）神经元器件严重依赖分立元件，极大地限制了芯片的集成密度和规模化应用。
AI.method: 采用CMOS兼容平台，在低于430 °C的工艺温度下，通过脉冲激光沉积（PLD）在介质隔离的绝缘体上硅（SOI）p型无 junction 场效应晶体管（JLFET）上方制备VO2纳米片，实现了单晶体管-单VO2忆阻器（1T-1MR）脉冲神经元的后段制程（BEOL）单片集成。
AI.result: 60 nm薄的VO2器件（6 μm²活性面积）实现了40至410 kHz栅极可调的振荡，单次脉冲功耗低至18 pJ，室温静态功耗仅为8 μW（潜在可降至3 μW以下）；揭示了振荡频率对偏置电流和温度的非单调依赖性及随机放电特性；成功演示了压控振荡器功能以及由JLFET介导的两个纳米振荡器之间的片上电阻耦合。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了一条迈向高密度、高能效、单片集成Mott类脑硬件的有效路径，完全兼容未来的类脑计算与脉冲感知系统。
AI.translation: 类脑非布尔计算与感知能够实现高能效、容错且高度并行的数据处理，但其应用仍受限于缺乏紧凑且可扩展的脉冲硬件。Mott相变材料因其剧烈的绝缘体-金属相变能够提供类似神经元的阈值切换和振荡特性，从而提供了一条很有前景的路线。其中，二氧化钒（VO2）因其接近室温的相变温度、快速切换和可扩展性而备受关注。然而，现有的VO2神经元器件依赖分立元件，限制了集成密度。在此，我们报道了在CMOS兼容平台上单晶体管-单VO2忆阻器（1T-1MR）脉冲神经元的后段制程（BEOL）单片集成。在低于430 °C的温度下，通过脉冲激光沉积在介质隔离的绝缘体上硅（SOI）p型无结场效应晶体管（JLFET）顶部制备VO2纳米片。该架构在具有6 μm²活性面积的60 nm薄VO2器件中展示出40至410 kHz的栅极可调振荡，实现每次脉冲18 pJ的能耗以及室温下8 μW的功耗（潜在可实现3 μW以下的运行）。我们揭示了振荡频率对偏置电流和温度的非单调依赖性，并分析了依赖偏置的随机放电现象，阐明了集成VO2薄膜忆阻器的非线性物理机制。最后，我们演示了压控振荡器功能以及由JLFET介导的两个纳米振荡器之间的片上电阻耦合。这些结果建立了一条迈向高密度、高能效、单片集成Mott类脑硬件的途径，与未来的计算和脉冲感知系统兼容。
AI.summary: 本研究报道了一种基于CMOS兼容平台的后段制程（BEOL）单片集成1T-1MR VO2 Mott脉冲神经元。该器件展示了宽频栅极可调振荡、超低脉冲功耗和片上振荡器耦合特性，深入解析了集成VO2薄膜忆阻器的非线性物理机制，为高密度低功耗神经形态硬件发展奠定了基础。
AI.keywords: 二氧化钒 (VO2), 单片集成, Mott振荡器, 脉冲神经元, 类脑计算
AI.comments: 该研究成功将VO2 Mott相变材料通过低成本、低功耗的后段制程（BEOL）与CMOS兼容平台（SOI JLFET）实现单片集成，解决了传统VO2神经元器件依赖分立元件、集成度低的关键瓶颈。论文不仅展示了极低的单脉冲能效和可调谐振荡特性，还深入揭示了非线性物理机制，为高密度、超低功耗类脑计算和脉冲感知硬件的实际落地提供了重要技术路径。

title: Resource-Constrained Shortest Path with Polytopic Reset Sets
summary: This paper investigates the problem of computing the shortest path between two states under resource constraints in environments with resource-replenishment regions. Namely, the length of the path is limited by a budget that can be restored within polytopic replenishment regions. We show that the optimal path in this problem exhibits a distinct geometric structure: it consists of straight-line segments, changes direction at the edges of replenishment regions, and enters a sequence of replenishment regions in a feasible-connected space. We propose an approach to solve the continuous problem in two steps: using a graph-based approach, followed by convex programming. First, we define a graph whose nodes are possible waypoints of feasible paths, and the edges are the Euclidean distances between these nodes. To obtain a discrete set of nodes that ensure a feasible and near-optimal solution, we utilize a wavefront algorithm. With a sufficiently small spacing between wavefronts, the solution of the shortest path problem on this graph yields the optimal sequence of polytopes to visit. Next, we use convex optimization on this sequence of polytopes to refine the solution to optimality. A numerical experiment is presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach.

AI.title_translation: 具有多面体重置集的资源约束最短路径问题
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合波前图搜索与凸优化的两阶段算法，用于解决带多面体资源重置区域的资源约束最短路径问题。
AI.motivation: 在包含资源补充区域（多面体重置集）的连续环境中，计算满足资源（路径长度预算）约束条件下的两点间最优最短路径。
AI.method: 采用两阶段求解策略：首先利用波前算法构造离散节点图并求解最短路径，以确定路径需要穿过的最优多面体区域序列；随后在该多面体序列约束下应用凸优化算法，对路径节点位置进行精细化微调以获得全局最优解。
AI.result: 通过数值实验成功验证了所提两阶段算法求解资源约束最短路径问题的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的两阶段算法能够有效且精确地解决带有多面体资源重置集的连续资源约束最短路径问题。
AI.translation: 本文研究了在包含资源补充区域的环境中，在资源约束下计算两个状态之间最短路径的问题。具体而言，路径的长度受到预算的限制，而该预算可以在多面体补充区域内得到恢复。我们证明了该问题中的最优路径展现出独特的几何结构：它由直线段组成，在补充区域的边缘改变方向，并按顺序进入可行连接空间中的一系列补充区域。我们提出了一种分两步解决该连续问题的方法：首先使用基于图的方法，随后进行凸规划。首先，我们定义一个图，其节点是可行路径的可能航点，边是这些节点之间的欧几里得距离。为了获得能够确保可行且近乎最优解的离散节点集，我们利用了波前算法。在波前间隔足够小的情况下，在该图上求解最短路径问题可以得到要访问的最优多面体序列。接下来，我们对该多面体序列使用凸优化，将解精炼至全局最优。最后展示了数值实验以证明该方法的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文针对包含多面体资源补充区域的环境，研究了资源约束下的最短路径规划问题。通过揭示最优路径由直线段构成且在补充区域边界改变方向的几何特性，提出了一种结合波前图搜索与凸优化的两阶段求解算法，并在数值实验中验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 资源约束最短路径, 多面体补充区域, 波前算法, 凸优化, 路径规划
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于揭示了带资源重置区域的最短路径问题的几何结构特征（直线段与边缘转向），并据此提出了结合波前算法（离散图搜索）与凸优化的两阶段求解框架。这种将连续优化与图搜索结合的方法兼顾了全局搜索能力与局部精度。局限性在于波前算法的网格/波前间隔设定对计算复杂度有较大影响。

title: Private Private Information in Second-Price Auction
summary: Classic results show that even an arbitrarily small correlation across bidders' information can enable full surplus extraction in auctions and related mechanism design settings. Motivated by this fragility, we study the information independence in a second-price auction when the seller commits to a private private information structure, meaning bidders' signals are independent ex ante, while bidders share a symmetric and arbitrarily correlated prior distribution over their valuations. We first show that the seller optimal efficient outcome with full surplus extraction can always be implemented by a private private information structure that admits a Bayes Nash equilibrium. However, this equilibrium may not be stable. We then further construct a private private information structure that achieves revenue arbitrarily close to maximum welfare while admitting a strict equilibrium. At the same time, we establish an impossibility result: under private private information, in general, bidder surplus cannot achieve maximal welfare exactly, and we characterize necessary and sufficient conditions on the prior distribution under which bidder surplus can be made arbitrarily close to maximal welfare. We finally explore which other efficient outcomes are achievable under private private information.

AI.title_translation: 二价拍卖中的私有私有信息
AI.tldr: 本文探讨了二价拍卖中“私有私有信息结构”对卖方收益与竞标者剩余的影响，证明了严格均衡下可实现接近最大福利的收益，并给出了竞标者剩余极大化的充要条件。
AI.motivation: 经典的拍卖理论表明，竞标者信息之间即使存在极小的相关性也可能导致卖家提取全部剩余，这一结果具有脆弱性。为了探索信息独立性在更稳健机制中的作用，研究者探讨了在二价拍卖中卖家承诺某种特定信息结构时的收益与效率边界。
AI.method: 作者构建了一种“私有私有信息结构”（即竞标者信号在事前独立，但对估值共享对称且任意相关的先验分布），分析并证明了在此结构下贝叶斯纳什均衡和严格均衡的可实现性，同时推导了竞标者剩余达到最大福利的充分必要条件。
AI.result:
1. 证明了卖家最优的极佳效率结果（全剩余提取）总能通过包含贝叶斯纳什均衡的私有私有信息结构实现，但该均衡可能不稳定；
2. 构建了一种能实现严格均衡且收益任意接近最大福利的私有私有信息结构；
3. 证明了在私有私有信息下，竞标者剩余通常无法精确达到最大福利，并给出了其能够任意接近最大福利的充要条件；
4. 探讨了私有私有信息下可实现的其他有效率结果。
AI.conclusion: 在私有私有信息结构下，卖家可以通过设计信息结构在二价拍卖中实现接近最大福利的收益，但竞标者剩余一般无法完全达到最大福利，其可接近程度取决于具体的先验概率分布。
AI.translation: 经典结果表明，即使竞标者信息之间仅存在极小的相关性，也能在拍卖及相关机制设计设定中实现全剩余提取。受这种脆弱性的启发，我们研究了二价拍卖中的信息独立性——此时卖家承诺一种私有私有信息结构，即竞标者的信号在事前是独立的，同时竞标者对他们的估值共享一个对称且任意相关的先验分布。我们首先表明，实现全剩余提取的卖家最优有效率结果总可以通过包含贝叶斯纳什均衡的私有私有信息结构来实现。然而，该均衡可能不稳定。随后，我们进一步构建了一种私有私有信息结构，它既能包含严格均衡，又能实现任意接近最大福利的收益。同时，我们得出了一个不可能性结果：在私有私有信息下，通常竞标者剩余无法精确达到最大福利；我们刻画了在此先验分布下竞标者剩余能够任意接近最大福利的充分必要条件。最后，我们探讨了在私有私有信息下还可以实现哪些其他有效率的结果。
AI.summary: 本文研究了二价拍卖中 seller 承诺“私有私有信息结构”时的信息独立性问题。研究表明，虽然全剩余提取在贝叶斯纳什均衡下可行但可能不稳定，但通过构建特定信息结构可以在严格均衡下实现接近最大福利的收益。此外，文章揭示了竞标者剩余无法精确达到最大福利的不可能性，并给出了其充要条件。
AI.keywords: 二价拍卖, 私有私有信息, 全剩余提取, 信息设计, 机制设计
AI.comments: 本文针对经典拍卖理论中“小相关性即可导致全剩余提取”这一脆弱性结论，提出了“私有私有信息结构”的概念，兼具很强的理论创新性与机制设计价值。研究不仅探讨了可实现性与稳定性（严格均衡），还给出了关于竞标者剩余的不可能性结果，深化了对拍卖中信息设计与收益分配关系的理解。

title: Templates in Rewriting Induction
summary:
Rewriting Induction (RI) is a formal system in term rewriting to establish program equivalence.    The recently defined Bounded RI for higher-order Logically Constrained Term Rewriting Systems (LCSTRSs) yields a convenient proof system for analyzing real programming code.
  A practical challenge in RI is the automatic generation of induction hypotheses, called lemmas.  While various lemma generation techniques exist for plain term rewriting, there are much fewer that consider the intricacies brought on by calculations or constraints. Taking advantage of recent developments in higher-order RI, we here present a new approach based on templates, which operates by recognising typical programming constructs as instances of higher-order functions. While templates have been used as a stand-alone method to justify the correctness of program transformations, we here consider their integration in Bounded RI to obtain a complementary lemma generation heuristic. This allows us to prove equivalences that were previously out of reach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将基于模板的引理生成启发式策略集成到高阶有限重写归纳法（Bounded RI）中，成功证明了先前无法处理的程序等价性。
AI.motivation: 在重写归纳法（RI）中，自动生成归纳假设（即引理）是一个切实的难题。现有的引理生成技术大多仅适用于普通项重写，极少有方法能处理由计算或逻辑约束带来的复杂性。
AI.method: 利用高阶RI的发展，提出一种基于模板的新方法。该方法通过将典型编程构造识别为高阶函数的实例，并将其作为互补的引理生成启发式策略集成到有限重写归纳法（Bounded RI）中。
AI.result: 该方法成功突破了现有技术的局限，能够证明先前无法达到的程序等价性。
AI.conclusion: 将模板匹配机制集成到Bounded RI中，为处理高阶逻辑约束项重写系统的程序等价性验证提供了一种强大的引理自动生成手段。
AI.translation: 重写归纳法（RI）是项重写中用于建立程序等价性的形式化系统。最近针对高阶逻辑约束项重写系统（LCTRSs）定义的有限RI（Bounded RI）提供了一个用于分析真实代码的便捷证明系统。RI中的一个实际挑战是归纳假设（即引理）的自动生成。尽管针对普通项重写存在多种引理生成技术，但考虑由计算或约束带来的复杂性的技术却少得多。利用高阶RI的最新发展，我们在本文中提出了一种基于模板的新方法，该方法通过将典型的编程构造识别为高阶函数的实例来运行。虽然模板此前被用作验证程序转换正确性的独立方法，但我们在本文中探讨了将其集成到有限RI中，以获得互补的引理生成启发式策略。这使我们能够证明先前无法达到的等价性。
AI.summary: 本文针对高阶逻辑约束项重写系统（LCTRSs）中重写归纳法（RI）引理自动生成困难的问题，提出了一种基于模板的引理生成启发式策略，并将其集成到Bounded RI框架中，从而拓展了程序自动等价性证明的能力范围。
AI.keywords: 重写归纳法, 逻辑约束项重写系统, 引理生成, 模板, 程序等价性
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于巧妙地将模板匹配技术与高阶有限重写归纳法（Bounded RI）结合，解决了在带有计算与约束的复杂高阶程序中自动生成归纳引理的难题。其重要性在于显著提升了自动化程序分析和等价性证明的实用能力。局限性在于该方法的有效性很大程度上依赖于预定义模板的完备性与覆盖范围。

title: SynSur: An end-to-end generative pipeline for synthetic industrial surface defect generation and detection
summary: Industrial surface defect inspection suffers from a fundamental data bottleneck: defects are rare, annotations require expert knowledge, and collecting balanced training sets is slow and costly. We present SynSur, an end-to-end pipeline for synthetic defect generation and automatic annotation, designed to reduce the manual effort and data scarcity that limit deployed inspection systems. The pipeline combines Vision-Language-Model-based prompt construction, LoRA-adapted diffusion, mask-guided inpainting, metric-based sample filtering, and automatic label derivation. We evaluate SynSur on BSData (pitting defects on ball screw drives) and the scratch subset of MSD, reporting downstream detection performance across YOLOX, YOLOv26, and LW-DETR under real-only, synthetic-only, mixed, and union training regimes. The full generation pipeline processes a candidate pool of 1,000 images and delivers a filtered, annotated synthetic dataset with no manual labeling effort. Synthetic-only training does not replace real data; however, augmenting the full real set with synthetic samples yields consistent AP gains in selected configurations, and augmenting scarce real sets substantially reduces the performance gap to full real-data training. The cross-domain study on MSD confirms pipeline portability while highlighting the importance of domain-specific adaptation and annotation quality control. SynSur demonstrates that diffusion-based defect synthesis is a practically viable tool for strengthening industrial inspection pipelines, particularly where labeled data collection is the primary bottleneck.

AI.title_translation: SynSur：用于合成工业表面缺陷生成与检测的端到端生成式管线
AI.tldr: SynSur是一个端到端的工业缺陷合成与自动标注管线，利用扩散模型和VLM无须人工标注即可生成高质量合成缺陷数据，有效提升稀缺数据下的缺陷检测性能。
AI.motivation: 工业表面缺陷检测面临严重的数据瓶颈：缺陷样本稀少、标注需要专家知识、且收集平衡的训练集耗时费力。
AI.method: 提出了SynSur端到端管线，集成了基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的提示词构建、LoRA微调的扩散模型、掩码引导局部修复（Inpainting）、基于指标的样本过滤以及自动标签生成技术。
AI.result: 在BSData和MSD数据集上的测试表明，SynSur无需人工标注即可从1000张候选图中筛选并标注合成数据集；用合成数据增强真实数据在特定配置下能显著提高AP，并在真实数据匮乏时大幅缩小与全量真实数据训练的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: SynSur表明基于扩散模型的缺陷合成是一种切实可行的工具，能够有效增强工业检测管线，特别是在标注数据收集成为主要瓶颈的场景中。
AI.translation: 工业表面缺陷检测面临着根本性的数据瓶颈：缺陷罕见、标注需要专家知识，且收集平衡的训练集既缓慢又昂贵。我们提出了SynSur，这是一个用于合成缺陷生成和自动标注的端到端管线，旨在减少限制部署检测系统的手动工作和数据匮乏问题。该管线结合了基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的提示词构建、LoRA微调的扩散模型、掩码引导的局部修复、基于指标的样本过滤以及自动标签推导。我们在BSData（滚珠丝杠上的点蚀缺陷）和MSD的划痕子集上评估了SynSur，报告了YOLOX、YOLOv26和LW-DETR在纯真实、纯合成、混合和联合训练机制下的下游检测性能。完整的生成管线处理了1,000张候选图像池，并在无需任何人工标注工作的情况下交付了一个经过过滤、自动标注的合成数据集。纯合成训练并不能取代真实数据；然而，用合成样本增强完整的真实数据集可以在选定的配置中带来持续的AP提升，而增强稀缺的真实数据集则能大幅缩小与全量真实数据训练之间的性能差距。MSD上的跨领域研究证实了管线的可移植性，同时强调了特定领域自适应和标注质量控制的重要性。SynSur表明，基于扩散模型的缺陷合成是一种切实可行的工具，可以增强工业检测管线，特别是在标注数据收集为主要瓶颈的情况下。
AI.summary: 本文针对工业表面缺陷检测中数据少、标注难的问题，提出了端到端生成管线SynSur，结合VLM提示构建、扩散模型修复与自动过滤标注，实现了无需人工参与的高质量缺陷合成与自动标注，并在多个检测模型和数据集上验证了其增强检测性能的有效性。
AI.keywords: 工业缺陷检测, 缺陷合成, 扩散模型, 自动标注, 数据增强
AI.comments: 该论文提出了针对工业缺陷检测中数据匮乏和标注成本高企问题的端到端合成解决方案，创新性地结合了VLM提示构建、LoRA微调扩散模型与自动滤波标注，具有很高的实用价值。局限性在于纯合成数据目前仍无法完全替代真实数据，且跨领域推广时对质量控制和领域自适应要求较高。

title: Joint Transceiver Orientation Optimization for Rotatable-Antenna MIMO Capacity Maximization
summary: Conventional multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems mainly rely on fixed antenna arrays, which limits their capability to adapt the effective channel matrix to the propagation environment. Rotatable antennas (RAs), which enable mechanical or electronic adjustment of antenna boresight directions, introduce a new orientation-domain degree of freedom for channel reconfiguration. In this paper, we investigate an RA-aided MIMO communication system for channel capacity enhancement. We first establish an orientation-dependent MIMO channel model. Then, we formulate a capacity maximization problem by jointly optimizing the transmit covariance matrix and the transmit/receive RA orientations under practical spherical-cap constraints. To solve this non-convex problem, we develop an alternating optimization algorithm, where the transmit covariance matrix is updated via eigenmode transmission and water-filling, while each RA orientation is optimized through a Riemannian Frank-Wolfe method. We further investigate the low-SNR regime and derive simplified designs for multiple-input single-output (MISO) and single-input multiple-output (SIMO) special cases. Numerical results show that the proposed RA-aided MIMO design significantly improves the channel capacity compared with the fixed-orientation benchmark, demonstrating the benefits of orientation-domain channel reconfiguration.

AI.title_translation: 基于可旋转天线MIMO容量最大化的收发机朝向联合优化
AI.tldr: 本文提出了利用可旋转天线（RA）重构MIMO信道的联合朝向与预编码优化算法，显著提升了通信信道容量。
AI.motivation: 传统MIMO系统采用固定天线阵列，限制了其根据无线传播环境调整有效信道矩阵的能力。可旋转天线通过调整天线主辐射方向，引入了朝向域自由度，以实现信道重构并提升信道容量。
AI.method: 建立朝向依赖的MIMO信道模型；在球冠约束下构建容量最大化问题；提出交替优化算法，结合特征模式传输/水注法（优化发送协方差矩阵）与黎曼Frank-Wolfe方法（优化天线朝向）；针对低信噪比以及MISO/SIMO特例推导简化设计。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，与固定朝向的基准方案相比，所提出的RA辅助MIMO设计能显著提高信道容量，证实了朝向域信道重构带来的性能优势。
AI.conclusion: 可旋转天线为MIMO信道重构提供了朝向域的新自由度。通过联合优化收发天线朝向与发送协方差矩阵，可以显著提升MIMO系统的信道容量。
AI.translation: 传统的多输入多输出（MIMO）系统主要依赖固定天线阵列，这限制了其根据传播环境自适应调整有效信道矩阵的能力。可旋转天线（RA）能够对天线主辐射方向进行机械或电子调节，为信道重构引入了朝向域的新自由度。在本文中，我们研究了用于增强信道容量的RA辅助MIMO通信系统。我们首先建立了朝向依赖的MIMO信道模型。然后，在实际的球冠约束下，通过联合优化发送协方差矩阵和发送/接收RA朝向，构建了容量最大化问题。为了解决这一非凸问题，我们开发了一种交替优化算法，其中发送协方差矩阵通过特征模式传输和水注法进行更新，而每个RA朝向则通过黎曼Frank-Wolfe方法进行优化。我们进一步研究了低信噪比（SNR）状态，并推导了多输入单输出（MISO）和单输入多输出（SIMO）特例的简化设计。数值结果表明，与固定朝向基准相比，所提出的RA辅助MIMO设计显著提高了信道容量，证明了朝向域信道重构的优势。
AI.summary: 本文研究了可旋转天线（RA）辅助的MIMO通信系统容量最大化问题。首先构建了朝向依赖的信道模型，随后在实用的球冠约束下联合优化发送协方差矩阵与收发天线朝向。提出了基于特征模式传输/水注法和黎曼Frank-Wolfe方法的交替优化算法，并分析了低信噪比及MISO/SIMO等特例。仿真验证了该方案相比固定天线朝向方案的显著容量增益。
AI.keywords: 可旋转天线, MIMO信道容量, 天线朝向优化, 黎曼Frank-Wolfe方法, 信道重构
AI.comments: 该论文将天线朝向这一机械/电子可调的新自由度引入MIMO系统，填补了现有流形优化在物理天线朝向约束下应用的空白。创新点在于建立了朝向依赖的物理信道模型，并利用黎曼Frank-Wolfe方法解决了非凸球冠约束下的优化难题。局限性在于主要依赖仿真验证，且未深入探讨天线机械旋转的延时与能耗对实时通信的影响。

title: FES-FM: Free Energy Surface Sampling via Reduced Flow Matching
summary: Sampling the distribution of collective variables (CVs) and estimating the associated free energy surface are crucial problems in statistical physics, as they underpin a better understanding of chemical reactions and conformational transitions. Traditional methods usually rely on simulations in high-dimensional configuration space and project the resulting configurations onto the CV space. To improve sampling speed, we propose FES-FM, a reduced flow matching (FM) method for free energy surface (FES) sampling. We train a dynamical transport map in the CV space, thereby enabling direct sampling of CV distributions and reconstruction of the corresponding free energy surface. For many-particle systems, we construct a prior distribution based on the Hessian at a local minimum of the potential, which ensures both rotation-translation invariance and physically meaningful configurations. We evaluate the proposed method across a variety of potential functions and collective variables, including alanine dipeptide in implicit solvent as a molecular benchmark. Comparative experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves sampling speed while maintaining accuracy.

title: Collusion Relations and their Applications to Balance Theory
summary: We study quadrangular properties of binary relations on a set X -i.e., properties defined on configurations of four elements -- within an agonistic interpretation, where xRy is interpreted as x "attacks" y. Such relations induce a suitable notion of "protection," and we provide necessary and sufficient conditions for this notion to be consistent. We characterize the balance property in signed frames in terms of a specific quadrangular property, namely collusivity. In this way, we generalize a classical result in balance theory by offering an alternative method for determining whether a network is polarized. That is, one can identify well-formed groups of agents that agree with one another within the same group (a set of allies) while disagreeing with, or attacking, agents outside the group. Furthermore, we extend the balance theorem to non-symmetric relations, thereby relaxing a condition required in standard balance theory. We conclude by giving a modal characterization of collusive frames, together with corresponding rules in a labeled sequent calculus, and we show that previous modal characterizations of balance are derivable within this system.

AI.title_translation: 勾结关系及其在平衡理论中的应用
AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于四元关系的“勾结性”概念，将传统平衡理论推广至非对称网络，并建立了相应的模态逻辑与序列演算系统。
AI.motivation: 传统平衡理论通常要求关系具有对称性，本文旨在放松这一限制，将其推广至非对称关系，并提供一种判别网络极化（即划分互为盟友且共同对抗外敌的群体）的替代方法及逻辑学基础。
AI.method: 基于竞争性解释（将关系视为“攻击”），研究四元二元关系性质，提出“保护”与“勾结性（collusivity）”概念；利用勾结性刻画符号框架的平衡性并推广至非对称关系；最后构造模态逻辑刻画及标记序列演算（labeled sequent calculus）系统。
AI.result: 1. 给出了“保护”概念一致性的充要条件；2. 实现了平衡理论向非对称二元关系的推广，提供了判定网络极化的新方法；3. 给出了勾结框架的模态刻画与标记序列演算规则，证明了以往平衡模态刻画在该系统中的可推导性。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将平衡定理推广至非对称二元关系，并为勾结框架建立了完备的模态逻辑与演化系统。
AI.translation: 我们在竞争性解释（其中 xRy 被解释为 x “攻击” y）下，研究了集合 X 上二元关系的四元性质——即定义在四个元素配置上的性质。此类关系引入了恰当的“保护”概念，且我们给出了该概念保持一致的充要条件。我们通过一种具体的四元性质（即勾结性）刻画了符号框架中的平衡性质。通过这种方式，我们提供了一种确定网络是否极化的替代方法，从而推广了平衡理论中的经典结果。也就是说，人们可以识别出结构良好的智能体群体，同一群体内的智能体彼此认同（盟友集），同时与群体外的智能体持不同意见或对其发起攻击。此外，我们将平衡定理扩展到非对称关系，从而放松了标准平衡理论所必需的条件。最后，我们给出了勾结框架的模态刻画以及标记序列演算中的相应规则，并证明了以往平衡的模态刻画可在该系统内推导出来。
AI.summary: 本研究探索了集合上二元关系的四元性质，提出了基于攻击与保护概念的“勾结性”。研究通过勾结性刻画了符号框架中的平衡性质，将传统平衡理论推广至非对称关系网络，从而能够识别网络中一致对外攻击的极化群体。此外，作者给出了勾结框架的模态刻画及其标记序列演算系统，验证了既有平衡逻辑的可推导性。
AI.keywords: 勾结关系, 平衡理论, 非对称网络, 模态刻画, 标记序列演算
AI.comments: 本文创新性地将四元性质（特别是“勾结性”）引入平衡理论，成功将传统的网络平衡理论推广到了非对称关系网络中，放松了标准平衡理论的对称性限制。同时，结合模态逻辑和标记序列演算，为网络极化现象和社交网络平衡提供了严密的逻辑与表达工具，具有显著的理论价值。

title: Efficient Decision Procedures for RNmatrix Semantics
summary: Logical matrices provide a semantic framework in which connectives are interpreted by deterministic truth-functions. While elegant, this approach is often too restrictive to capture the semantics of many non-classical logics. Non-deterministic matrices (Nmatrices) generalise ordinary matrices by allowing connectives to return a set of possible truth values rather than a unique one, thereby increasing expressive power. Restricted non-deterministic matrices (RNmatrices) further refine this framework by imposing constraints on the rows of Nmatrices, filtering out "unsound" rows and retaining only "valid" ones. This yields a more expressive semantic framework that has been successfully used to provide sound and complete semantics for a wide range of logics, including paraconsistent, intuitionistic, and modal logics. Despite these advances, no efficient decision procedures based on RNmatrix semantics have been proposed. In this paper, we develop automated theorem provers based on RNmatrices by encoding their semantics as Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) problems. The resulting provers decide validity and construct countermodels, achieving state-of-the-art performance for paraconsistent logics and competitive results for intuitionistic and modal logics.

AI.title_translation: RNmatrix 语义的高效判定程序
AI.tldr: 本文通过将受限非确定性矩阵（RNmatrices）语义编码为 SMT 问题，开发出了适用于多种非经典逻辑的高效自动定理证明器。
AI.motivation: 尽管受限非确定性矩阵（RNmatrices）成功为次协调、直觉主义和模态逻辑等多种非经典逻辑提供了可靠且完备的语义，但此前一直缺乏基于 RNmatrix 语义的高效判定程序。
AI.method: 通过将 RNmatrices 的语义编码为可满足性模理论（Satisfiability Modulo Theories, SMT）问题，开发了基于 RNmatrices 的自动定理证明器。
AI.result: 所开发的自动定理证明器能够判定逻辑公式的有效性并构造反模型，在次协调逻辑上取得了当前最优（SOTA）的性能，并在直觉主义逻辑和模态逻辑上取得了极具竞争力的表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过将 RNmatrix 语义转化为 SMT 问题，能够构建出适用于多种非经典逻辑的高效自动化判定程序与反模型生成工具。
AI.translation: 逻辑矩阵提供了一个语义框架，其中联结词由确定性真值函数解释。尽管这种方法非常优雅，但它通常过于严格，无法捕获许多非经典逻辑的语义。非确定性矩阵（Nmatrices）通过允许联结词返回一组可能的真值而不是单一真值来推广普通矩阵，从而增强了表达能力。受限非确定性矩阵（RNmatrices）通过对 Nmatrices 的行施加约束，过滤掉“不可靠”的行并仅保留“有效”的行，进一步完善了这一框架。这提供了一个更有表达力的语义框架，已成功用于为包括次协调逻辑、直觉主义逻辑和模态逻辑在内的广泛逻辑提供可靠且完备的语义。尽管取得了这些进展，但目前尚未提出基于 RNmatrix 语义的高效判定程序。在本文中，我们通过将其语义编码为可满足性模理论（SMT）问题，开发了基于 RNmatrices 的自动定理证明器。由此产生的证明器可以判定有效性并构建反模型，在次协调逻辑方面达到了最新（SOTA）的性能，并在直觉主义逻辑和模态逻辑方面取得了极具竞争力的结果。
AI.summary: 本文针对非经典逻辑中缺少基于受限非确定性矩阵（RNmatrix）语义的高效判定程序这一难题，提出了一种将 RNmatrix 语义编码为 SMT 问题的自动化定理证明方法。该方法不仅能判定逻辑有效性，还能构造反模型，并在次协调、直觉主义及模态逻辑的判定任务中展现出卓越的性能。
AI.keywords: RNmatrix 语义, 自动定理证明, SMT 编码, 非经典逻辑, 判定程序
AI.comments: 本文创新性地将形式逻辑中的高表达力语义框架（RNmatrices）与现代高效的求解技术（SMT）相结合，填补了基于 RNmatrix 语义的高效判定程序与自动化工具的空白。其成果在次协调逻辑上达到了 SOTA 性能，展现了极高的实用价值。潜在的局限性在于摘要未讨论针对大规模逻辑公式时 SMT 编码的规模扩展性与计算复杂度。

title: Rewriting the Response Path: Silent Tampering and Provider-Signed Defense in BYOK LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents convert model outputs into consequential actions, including communications, code changes, and financial transactions. Developers often trust evidence such as test results and execution logs. We identify a response path integrity gap in Bring Your Own Key configurations used by roughly 88 percent of mainstream agents. Because traffic passes through a user-authorized relay, the relay can modify plaintext LLM responses after alignment but before execution without breaking encryption. A minimal attack rewrites one execution bearing field and regenerates the remaining response using the user key while preserving the model style. Experiments reveal false green verification, where malicious code modifications pass public tests while silently defeating security checks. On APPS, 99.7 percent of publicly passing solutions retained downgraded behavior without developer-visible warnings. Tests on SWE bench, AgentDojo, and ASB across five frontier models show that single-field rewriting can redirect agents while preserving apparent task completion. We propose sign-c, a server-side scheme that authenticates execution bearing fields and outgoing queries. A local shim verifies them before action, while encryption protects confidentiality. The defense rejected all tampered responses with zero false rejections and only 0.0167 percent latency overhead.

AI.title_translation: 重写响应路径：自带密钥（BYOK）LLM Agent中的静默篡改与服务商签名防御
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了BYOK LLM Agent中中继节点可静默篡改模型响应的安全漏洞，并提出了一种零误报、超低开销的服务端签名防御方案sign-c。
AI.motivation: 在约88%主流LLM Agent采用的自带密钥（BYOK）配置中，网络流量通常通过用户授权的中继节点传输。尽管传输层存在加密，但中继节点可在明文响应被Agent执行前进行静默篡改，导致响应路径存在严重完整性风险。
AI.method:
1. **攻击方法**：利用BYOK模式下流量经过中继节点的特点，在模型响应对齐后、执行前修改单个关键执行字段，并使用用户密钥重新生成后续内容以保持模型风格一致。
2. **防御方案（sign-c）**：设计了一种服务端签名机制，对模型响应中的关键执行字段及传出查询进行加密签名；本地客户端通过Shim组件在执行操作前验证签名，确保响应未被篡改。
AI.result: 在APPS基准测试中，99.7%通过公开测试的解法保留了降级/恶意行为且无警告提示；在SWE-bench、AgentDojo等数据集上的实验证实单字段篡改即可成功重定向Agent。防御方案sign-c成功拦截了所有篡改响应，误报率为0，且带来的延迟开销仅为0.0167%。
AI.conclusion: BYOK架构下缺乏对模型响应完整性的验证会导致严重的静默劫持风险。通过在服务端引入针对执行字段的签名机制（sign-c）并在客户端进行验证，可以在不增加明显延迟的前提下彻底消除此类响应路径篡改威胁。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）Agent将模型输出转化为具有实际影响的操作，包括通信、代码修改和金融交易。开发者通常信任测试结果和执行日志等证据。我们发现在大约88%的主流Agent所使用的自带密钥（BYOK）配置中存在响应路径完整性缝隙。由于流量经过用户授权的中继，中继可以在模型对齐之后、执行之前修改明文LLM响应，且不会破坏传输加密。一种极简攻击可以通过重写一个执行相关字段，并使用用户密钥重新生成剩余响应，同时保持模型风格不变。实验揭露了“假绿灯验证”现象，即恶意代码修改能够通过公开测试，同时静默规避安全检查。在APPS数据集上，99.7%在公开测试中通过的解法保留了降级行为且没有显示开发者可见的警告。对跨5个前沿模型的SWE-bench、AgentDojo和ASB的测试表明，单字段重写可以在保持表面任务完成度的同时重定向Agent。我们提出了sign-c，一种服务端方案，用于验证执行字段和传出查询。本地shim在执行操作前对其进行验证，同时加密保障机密性。该防御拒绝了所有被篡改的响应，零误拒绝，且仅带来0.0167%的延迟开销。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了BYOK（自带密钥）LLM Agent中的安全缺陷，揭示了中继节点可在不破坏加密的前提下静默篡改模型响应并绕过安全检查。作者提出了服务端签名防御机制sign-c，通过对执行字段签名并在本地客户端校验，以极低的延迟开销和零误报完美防御此类篡改攻击。
AI.keywords: LLM Agent, BYOK, 响应路径完整性, 静默篡改, 服务端签名
AI.comments:
1. **创新性**：首次揭示了BYOK（自带密钥）LLM Agent架构中由于中继节点的存在所导致的“响应路径完整性盲区”，打破了传输层加密即绝对安全的传统认知。
2. **重要性**：影响范围广泛（约88%的主流Agent），展示了恶意篡改如何静默绕过自动化代码测试并造成“假绿灯”现象，对Agent应用的安全落地具有极高的预警价值。
3. **局限性**：论文摘要未探讨服务商签名机制在多厂商协作或复杂中间件生态中的密钥管理成本与兼容性问题。

title: Design and Analysis of Quantum Dual-Containing CSS LDPC Codes based on Quasi-Dyadic Matrices
summary: Quantum error correcting codes are essential to achieve fault-tolerant quantum computation. This work introduces two constructions of high-rate, dual-containing (DC) Calderbank--Shor--Steane low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes based on quasi-dyadic matrices. We characterize the automorphism group of such codes, investigate their minimum distance behavior, and provide several theoretical results on their cycle properties. Monte Carlo simulations under depolarizing and phenomenological noise show better finite-length logical error rates than the considered DC benchmark codes and competitive performance against several state-of-the-art quantum LDPC code families. Finally, we employ an automorphism-ensemble belief propagation decoder to improve their decoding performance.

AI.title_translation: 基于准二元矩阵的量子双包含CSS LDPC码的设计与分析
AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于准二元矩阵的高码率双包含CSS LDPC码构造方法及自同构集合译码器，显著提升了容错量子计算中的逻辑误码率性能。
AI.motivation: 量子纠错码是实现容错量子计算的关键，需要构建具有优良结构特性和高性能的高码率双包含CSS LDPC码。
AI.method: 1. 提出两种基于准二元矩阵的高码率双包含（DC）CSS LDPC码构造方法；2. 对代码的自同构群进行刻画，分析其最小距离行为及环（cycle）的理论特性；3. 应用自同构集合置信传播（automorphism-ensemble belief propagation）解码器来提升译码性能。
AI.result: 在去极化噪声和现象学噪声下的蒙特卡洛模拟表明，该码字具有比传统DC基准码更优的有限长逻辑误码率，且性能与多种现有的先进量子LDPC码媲美。
AI.conclusion: 基于准二元矩阵的构建方法与自同构集合译码技术的结合，有效地提升了量子双包含CSS LDPC码的构造效率与纠错性能。
AI.translation: 量子纠错码对于实现容错量子计算至关重要。本工作介绍了基于准二元矩阵的高码率、双包含（DC）Calderbank--Shor--Steane低密度奇偶校验（LDPC）码的两种构造方法。我们刻画了此类代码的自同构群，研究了它们的最小距离行为，并给出了关于其环特性的若干理论结果。在去极化噪声和现象学噪声下的蒙特卡洛模拟表明，与所考虑的双包含基准码相比，该方法具有更好的有限长逻辑误码率，并且性能可与几种最先进的量子LDPC码族相媲美。最后，我们采用了自同构集合置信传播解码器来提高其译码性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了两种基于准二元矩阵的高码率双包含CSS LDPC码的构造方法，并深入分析了其自同构群、最小距离与环特性。结合自同构集合置信传播解码器，该方法在多种噪声模型下表现出优异的有限长逻辑误码率性能，为容错量子计算提供了高性能的码字选择。
AI.keywords: 量子纠错码, CSS LDPC码, 准二元矩阵, 置信传播译码, 容错量子计算
AI.comments: 本工作创新性地将准二元矩阵结构引入到量子双包含（DC）CSS LDPC码的构造中，并结合了自同构集合置信传播解码算法。论文不仅给出了严密的理论性质分析（如自同构群、环特性和最小距离），还通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证了其在有限长逻辑误码率上的优越性，对容错量子计算的码字设计与解码有重要价值。

title: Agent-Based Modeling of Low-Emission Fertilizer Adoption for Dairy Farm Decarbonisation using Empirical Farm Data
summary: To understand complex system dynamics in dairy farming requires tools that capture farm heterogeneity, social interactions, and cumulative environmental impacts. This study proposes an agent-based modelling(ABM) framework to simulate nitrogen management and low-emission fertiliser adoption across 295 Irish dairy farms over a 15-year period. Using empirical data, the model replicates farm communication through a social network, where adoption probabilities are driven by social contagion, farm-scale factors, and policy interventions such as subsidies and carbon taxes. The framework computes sectoral greenhouse gas emissions, cumulative abatement, and private-social costs, with Monte Carlo and sensitivity analyses quantifying uncertainty. The model achieved high predictive accuracy (R2 = 0.979, RMSE = 0.0274) and was validated against observed adoption data using a Kolmogorov-Smirnov test (D = 0.2407, p < 0.001). Adoption dynamics were fitted to Rogers logistic curves, reproducing a realistic saturation plateau (91%) while acknowledging structural laggard effects. By conceptualizing decarbonization as a socio-technical evolution rather than a purely monetary calculation, this study establishes an exploratory policy framework for evaluating the diffusion of climate strategies prior to implementation.

AI.title_translation: 基于经验农场数据的乳制品农场脱碳低排放肥料采用的主体建模
AI.tldr: 研究提出了一个基于主体建模（ABM）的框架，结合社会网络交流与政策干预，成功模拟和评估了低排放肥料在爱尔兰乳制品农场的普及动态与减排潜力。
AI.motivation: 理解乳业生产中复杂的系统动态，需要能够同时捕捉农场异质性、社会互动以及累积环境影响的模拟工具。
AI.method: 本研究构建了一个基于主体建模（ABM）的框架，利用经验数据模拟了爱尔兰295个乳制品农场在15年间对氮管理和低排放肥料的采用情况。模型通过社交网络模拟农场间的交流传播，将采用概率设定为由社会传染、农场规模特征以及补贴和碳税等政策干预共同驱动，并运用蒙特卡洛模拟和敏感性分析对不确定性进行了量化。
AI.result: 模型展现出极高的预测精度（R² = 0.979，RMSE = 0.0274），并通过Kolmogorov-Smirnov检验证明了其对观察到的采用数据的有效性（D = 0.2407, p < 0.001）。技术采用动态拟合了罗杰斯逻辑曲线，成功重现了91%的现实饱和平台，同时合理体现了结构性的落后者效应。
AI.conclusion: 本研究将脱碳过程概念化为社会技术演变而非单纯的经济计算，成功建立了一个探索性的政策评估框架，能够在气候干预策略正式实施前对其扩散效应进行科学评估。
AI.translation: 要理解乳业中复杂的系统动态，需要能够捕捉农场异质性、社会互动和累积环境影响的工具。本研究提出了一个基于主体建模（ABM）的框架，用于模拟15年间爱尔兰295个乳制品农场的氮管理和低排放肥料采用情况。模型利用经验数据，通过社交网络复制农场之间的交流，其中采用概率由社会传染、农场规模因素以及补贴和碳税等政策干预驱动。该框架计算了行业温室气体排放量、累积减排量和私有-社会成本，并利用蒙特卡洛和敏感性分析量化了不确定性。模型取得了极高的预测精度（R² = 0.979，RMSE = 0.0274），并使用Kolmogorov-Smirnov检验证实了与观察到的采纳数据一致（D = 0.2407，p < 0.001）。采纳动态拟合了罗杰斯逻辑曲线，重现了91%的现实饱和平台，同时承认了结构性的落后者效应。通过将脱碳概念化为社会技术演变而非单纯的经济计算，本研究建立了一个用于在实施前评估气候策略扩散的探索性政策框架。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个基于主体建模（ABM）的创新框架，结合爱尔兰295个乳制品农场的真实经验数据，模拟了社会网络交流和政策干预（如补贴、碳税）对低排放肥料普及及农业脱碳的影响。模型不仅具备极高的统计拟合精度，还揭示了技术扩散的社会技术演变特性，为政策制定者在政策实施前评估气候干预效果提供了有力工具。
AI.keywords: 基于主体建模, 低排放肥料, 农业脱碳, 社会传染, 政策评估
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将农业脱碳视为社会技术演变过程，巧妙地结合了社交网络传播机制与补贴、碳税等政策干预手段，弥补了传统纯经济计算模型的不足。此外，模型基于丰富的经验数据并获得了极高的拟合精度与统计验证，对农业减排政策的前瞻性评估具有重要的实用价值。局限性在于数据源于爱尔兰特定地区的农场，其结论向其他国家或农业生产模式泛化时可能需要重新校准。

title: Prober.ai: Gated Inquiry-Based Feedback via LLM-Constrained Personas for Argumentative Writing Development
comments: Prototype awarded second place at the NYEdTech Hackathon (March 2026) https://www.nyedtechhackathon.com/2026-submissions
summary: The proliferation of large language models (LLMs) in educational settings has paradoxically undermined the cognitive processes they purport to support. Students increasingly outsource critical thinking to AI assistants that generate polished text on demand, resulting in measurable cognitive debt and diminished argumentative reasoning skills. We present Prober.ai, a web-based writing environment that inverts the conventional AI-tutoring paradigm: rather than generating or rewriting student text, the system constrains an LLM (Gemini 3 Flash Preview) through persona-specific system prompts and structured JSON output schemas to produce only targeted, inquiry-based questions about argumentative weaknesses. A two-phase interaction architecture -- Challenge and Unlock -- implements a pedagogical friction mechanism whereby revision suggestions are gated behind mandatory student reflection. The system's design is grounded in Toulmin's argumentation theory, research on peer feedforward questioning mechanisms, and evidence on AI-supported feedback in writing instruction. A functional prototype was developed in 36 hours during the NY EdTech Hackathon (March 2026), where it was awarded second place. We describe the system architecture, the prompt engineering methodology for constraining LLM output to pedagogically aligned JSON schemas, and discuss implications for scalable, cognition-preserving AI integration in writing education.
comment: Prototype awarded second place at the NYEdTech Hackathon (March 2026) https://www.nyedtechhackathon.com/2026-submissions

AI.title_translation: Prober.ai：基于大模型受限角色的门控探究式反馈在议论文写作能力提升中的应用
AI.tldr: Prober.ai 翻转了传统 AI 代写模式，通过受限的大模型提供门控探究式提问，强制学生先反思再获取建议，从而提升议论文写作水平并保护批判性思维。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在教育领域的普及导致学生过度依赖AI生成或润色文本，剥夺了批判性思考过程，引发了认知负债及议论文推理能力的下降。
AI.method: 开发了基于 Web 的 Prober.ai 写作环境，使用 Gemini 3 Flash Preview 模型，通过特定角色的系统提示词和结构化 JSON 输出 Schema 约束 LLM，使其仅针对论证弱点生成有针对性的探究性提问；采用“挑战与解锁”（Challenge and Unlock）双阶段交互架构，设置教学摩擦机制，将修改建议门控于学生的强制性反思之后；理论基础涵盖图尔敏论证理论、同伴前馈提问机制及AI辅助写作反馈证据。
AI.result: 在 2026 年 3 月的纽约教育科技黑客松（NY EdTech Hackathon）中，团队在 36 小时内开发出了功能性原型并荣获第二名。
AI.conclusion: Prober.ai 展示了通过合理约束LLM输出以保持学生认知参与的可行性，为未来将AI以“保护认知能力”的方式规模化融入写作教学提供了重要参考。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）在教育场景中的普及，反常地削弱了其旨在支持的认知过程。学生越来越多地将批判性思维外包给可按需生成精美文本的 AI 助手，导致了可衡量的认知负债和论证推理能力的下降。我们展示了 Prober.ai，这是一个基于 Web 的写作环境，颠覆了传统的 AI 辅导范式：该系统并非生成或重写学生文本，而是通过特定角色的系统提示词和结构化 JSON 输出 Schema 来约束 LLM（Gemini 3 Flash Preview），仅生成针对论证弱点的目标探究式提问。一个名为“挑战与解锁”（Challenge and Unlock）的双阶段交互架构实现了教学摩擦机制，将修改建议门控（关卡化限制）在学生强制性的反思之后。该系统的设计基于图尔敏（Toulmin）论证理论、同伴前馈提问机制研究以及写作教学中 AI 支持反馈的证据。在 2026 年 3 月的纽约教育科技黑客松（NY EdTech Hackathon）期间，团队在 36 小时内开发出了一个功能原型，并获得了第二名。我们描述了系统架构、约束 LLM 输出至符合教学要求的 JSON Schema 的提示词工程方法，并讨论了其对写作教育中具有规模化且保护认知能力的 AI 集成所带来的启示。
AI.summary: Prober.ai 是一种旨在提升议论文写作能力的 Web 写作环境，它反转了传统 AI 辅导生成文本的范式。该系统利用受限的大语言模型角色和 JSON 输出约束，仅针对论证缺陷提出探究性问题，并通过“挑战与解锁”的双阶段门控机制强制学生先反思再获取修改建议，从而保护学生的认知参与和批判性思维。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 探究式反馈, 议论文写作, 教学摩擦, 图尔敏论证理论
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地颠覆了传统的AI代写/润色辅导模式，提出了“教学摩擦”（Pedagogical Friction）机制，通过反向约束大模型仅输出探究性提问，迫使学生自主思考与反思，有效地缓解了AI辅助教学中常见的“认知负债”问题。其结合图尔敏论证理论与结构化JSON输出限制的方法，具有较高的应用价值和实用推广前景。

title: Semantic Prior Guided One-View 6D Pose Estimation for Novel Objects
summary: In many practical 6D object pose estimation scenarios, we often have access to only a single real-world RGB-D reference view per object, typically without CAD models. Existing methods largely rely on explicit 3D models or multi-view data, which limits their scalability. To address this challenging single-reference model-free setting, we propose \textbf{OneViewAll}, a semantic-prior-guided framework that performs pose estimation via a novel Project-and-Compare paradigm. Instead of relying on computationally expensive CAD-based rendering, our method directly aligns reference and query observations within a projection-equivariant space. OneViewAll progressively integrates hierarchical semantic priors across three levels: (1) \textit{category- and scene-level} priors for efficient hypothesis initialization; (2) \textit{object-level symmetry} priors for geometry completion via mirror fusion; and (3) \textit{patch-level} priors for discriminative refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OneViewAll achieves \textbf{92.5\%} ADD-0.1 accuracy on the LINEMOD dataset using only one real reference view -- significantly outperforming the CVPR 2025 baseline One2Any (52.6\%). It also yields consistent improvements on YCB-V, Real275, and Toyota-Light while maintaining low inference latency. Our results underscore the efficacy of symmetry-aware projection in handling symmetric, texture-less, and occluded objects.

AI.title_translation: 基于语义先验指导的新物体单视图6D姿态估计
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种名为OneViewAll的框架，用于在只有单个RGB-D参考视图且无CAD模型的情况下进行6D物体姿态估计。该方法利用投影不变空间中的参考和查询观测，并整合了类别/场景、物体对称性和块级语义先验，实现了高效的姿态估计，在LINEMOD数据集上达到了92.5%的ADD-0.1准确率，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有6D物体姿态估计方法通常依赖于显式3D模型或多视图数据，这限制了它们在实际应用中的可扩展性，尤其是在只有一个真实世界RGB-D参考视图且无CAD模型的情况下。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为OneViewAll的语义先验引导框架，采用新颖的投影和比较范式。该方法直接在投影不变空间中对齐参考和查询观测，并逐步整合了三个层级的语义先验：类别/场景级先验用于假设初始化，物体对称性先验用于通过镜像融合完成几何，以及块级先验用于判别性细化。
AI.result: 在LINEMOD数据集上，使用单个真实参考视图，OneViewAll达到了92.5%的ADD-0.1准确率，显著优于基线方法One2Any（52.6%）。在YCB-V、Real275和Toyota-Light数据集上也取得了持续改进，同时保持了较低的推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调了对称感知投影在处理对称、无纹理和遮挡物体方面的有效性。OneViewAll在模型无关的单参考视图6D姿态估计任务中表现出色。
AI.translation: 在许多实际的6D物体姿态估计场景中，我们通常只有一个真实世界的RGB-D参考视图，并且通常没有CAD模型。现有方法在很大程度上依赖于显式的3D模型或多视图数据，这限制了它们的可扩展性。为了解决这种具有挑战性的单参考模型无关设置，我们提出了一种名为	extbf{OneViewAll}的语义先验引导框架，它通过一种新颖的投影和比较范式来进行姿态估计。我们的方法不是依赖于计算成本高昂的基于CAD的渲染，而是直接在投影不变空间中对齐参考和查询观测。OneViewAll逐步整合了三个层级的层次化语义先验：(1) 	extit{类别和场景级}先验用于高效的假设初始化；(2) 	extit{物体级对称性}先验用于通过镜像融合完成几何；以及 (3) 	extit{块级}先验用于判别性细化。广泛的实验表明，OneViewAll在使用单个真实参考视图的情况下，在LINEMOD数据集上达到了	extbf{92.5%}的ADD-0.1准确率——显著优于CVPR 2025基线One2Any（52.6%）。它在YCB-V、Real275和Toyota-Light上也能取得持续改进，同时保持较低的推理延迟。我们的结果强调了对称感知投影在处理对称、无纹理和遮挡物体方面的有效性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了OneViewAll框架，解决了在缺乏CAD模型和仅有一个真实参考视图的条件下进行6D物体姿态估计的挑战。该框架利用投影不变空间和多级语义先验（包括类别/场景、物体对称性和块级先验），通过新颖的投影-比较范式实现了高效的姿态估计。实验结果表明，OneViewAll在LINEMOD等数据集上取得了显著的性能提升，尤其在处理对称、无纹理和遮挡物体方面表现出色。
AI.keywords: 6D姿态估计, 单视图, 模型无关, 语义先验, 对称性
AI.comments: 该研究提出的OneViewAll框架在单视图、模型无关的6D姿态估计领域取得了显著进展，尤其是在处理具有挑战性的对称、无纹理和遮挡物体方面。其创新的投影-比较范式和多级语义先验的整合，有效克服了传统方法对CAD模型和多视图数据的依赖。然而，该方法在复杂场景下的泛化能力和对不同类型物体（如非刚性物体）的处理能力仍有待进一步探索。

title: Semantics-Aware Communication:A Differentiated Allocation Perspective
comments: 6 pages, 6 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: We study the joint optimization of timeliness and reliability in semantics-aware Wireless Networked Control Systems (WNCS) under computation resource constraints. The sampled data are categorized into regular and critical tasks based on the semantic states, facilitating differentiated resource allocation. Task-aware Age of Actuation (AoA) and Cost of Missing Actuation (CoMA), are used to characterize the task-level freshness and the reliability penalty of missed actuations, respectively. By modeling the controller as a discrete-time multi-rate Geo/D/C/C queue, we evaluate the performance of regular and critical tasks, the latter imposing higher computational demands. Results confirm that differentiated resource allocation across heterogeneous tasks effectively guarantees the actuation reliability of critical tasks in severely constrained environments.
